Витамин A.onset: In case of deficiency - course correction, weeks-months, under status control; the effect in healthy people (skin/hair) is not described in the abstracts.
Витамин A.title: Vitamin A
Витамин A.upper_limit: not established (not given in abstracts; fat soluble - toxicity possible)
Витамин A.who_needs: People with confirmed deficiency (risk is high if food is insecure - 89% of studies); AGA - the role of A is separately weak; healthy people without deficiency are not shown to benefit.

Витамин C.about: Antioxidant and cofactor: collagen, immunity, iron absorption.
Витамин C.caution: For ARI: prevention does NOT reduce the incidence in the general population (RR 0.96), BUT in extreme stress (marathon/skiing/army) it reduces by 50%. Therapy after symptoms begin does NOT work. For CVD: large RCTs showed no benefit. >2000 mg/day: GI side effects, risk of oxalate stones.
Витамин C.food_sources: Bell pepper, black currant, kiwi, citrus fruits, sauerkraut.
Витамин C.guidelines: EFSA: immunity and collagen; Cochrane: The common cold is slightly shorter lasting, but not less common in the general population.
Витамин C.how_to_choose: Regular ascorbic acid is sufficient; “liposomal and esterified” is an overpayment without strong data.

interactions.note: high doses may reduce the effect

mechs: Antioxidant protection of the immune system under extreme stress
Colds are half as common among marathon runners, skiers and military personnel (RR 0.50)
Antioxidant pathways in primary prevention of cardiovascular diseases
Витамин C.myths: “Prevents colds” - not in the general population. “Megadoses are safe” - GI and stones.
Витамин C.name: Vitamin C
Витамин C.onset: Subjectively no; in case of deficiency (gums, fatigue) - 1-2 weeks of replenishment.
Витамин C.title: Vitamin C
Витамин C.upper_limit: 2000 mg/day; higher - diarrhea and the risk of kidney stones in predisposed people.
Витамин C.who_needs: Smokers (+35 mg/day), few vegetables and fruits, extreme loads.

Витамин D.caution: The effect depends on the BASELINE 25(OH)D level. At >50 nmol/l there is almost no benefit. At <30 nmol/l - significant. A pre-appointment test is required. >4000 IU/long term: hypercalcemia, stones. Conflict with thiazides.
Витамин D.food_sources: Fatty fish, yolk, enriched milk; In winter there is not enough food.
Витамин D.guidelines: EFSA: bones and muscles; NIH: Recommends monitoring blood levels.
Витамин D.how_to_choose: D3 (cholecalciferol), not D2; oil capsules; dosage in IU on the label.
mechs: VDR receptors of the hippocampus → neurotrophins NGF/GDNF
1,25(OH)2D via VDR: intestinal calcium absorption, bone mineralization
Fewer fractures in older people, especially with calcium
Витамин D.myths: “The more, the better” - fat-soluble, accumulates. “There is enough summer sun for the winter” - a supply for 2-3 months.
Витамин D.name: Vitamin D
Витамин D.onset: Subjectively, no way: monitor the 25(OH)D analysis after 8-12 weeks.
Витамин D.title: Vitamin D
Витамин D.who_needs: Northern latitudes October-March, office work, dark skin, obesity, age 65+.

Витамин E.about: Membrane antioxidant: no effect on CVD/cancer in healthy people; for NAFLD - uncertain; tardive dyskinesia - weak conflicting data.
Витамин E.caution: Vitamin E is a fat-soluble antioxidant. 15 Cochrane reviews in the database! For tardive dyskinesia (a side effect of antipsychotics): there is evidence of improvement. For MASLD: there is Cochrane (2 years, 800 IU/day). For Alzheimer's: there is Cochrane, but the effect is clinically small. For CVD/cancer prevention in healthy individuals: NO effect (large RCT). Caution: >400 IU/day increases all-cause mortality in some MAs.
Витамин E.dosage: do not exceed 400 IU, preferably from food
effects: Prevention of CVD and mortality: not confirmed
Витамин E.food_sources: Nuts, vegetable oils, seeds - with a normal diet, deficiency is rare; Healthy people don't need supplements.
Витамин E.guidelines: Cochrane 2018: no clear difference with placebo for tardive dyskinesia; Alzheimer's - no; NAFLD—uncertain. The dose should not exceed 400 IU/day.
Витамин E.how_to_choose: Preferably from food; in supplements no higher than 400 IU. The form (alpha/s-mixed) is not critical - the data does not discriminate.

interactions.note: enhances the effect, risk of bleeding

mechs: Prevention of CVD and mortality: not confirmed
Reduces oxidative stress in the liver (antioxidant)
For NAFLD: benefit uncertain (16 RCT, 1066 people; Cochrane 2024)
Suppression of free radicals in nervous tissue
Cognition in AD and MCI: no clinically significant effect
Витамин E.myths: “Antioxidant for everything” – no effect for Alzheimer’s/MCI and CVD. “The more the merrier” - high doses (>400 IU) do not provide benefit; There are no mortality data in key sources.
Витамин E.name: Vitamin E
Витамин E.onset: Delayed effect: for NAFLD courses up to 2 years; clinically small, no immediate flush.
Витамин E.title: Vitamin E
Витамин E.who_needs: NAFLD - as prescribed by a doctor; analysis deficit. For tardive dyskinesia, the data are weak and contradictory (Cochrane).

Витамин K1.about: Vitamin K1: in MA the effect on cardio-metabolic factors is limited (HOMA-IR, CRP), in K2 the effect is more pronounced; bone data from reviews of K as a whole.
Витамин K1.caution: Metabolic effect is limited; Abstract data on the safety of high doses are sparse; If there is a clotting disorder, consult a doctor.
Витамин K1.dosage: Dosages of K1 are not given separately in the abstracts.
Витамин K1.food_sources: Leafy greens (spinach, cabbage, broccoli), green vegetables, vegetable oils; K1 is predominantly a plant source.
Витамин K1.guidelines: MA 2024 (17 RCT): vitamin K reduces HOMA-IR (WMD -0.24), other - no; MA 2019 (13 RCT): CRP and sensitivity index only; review 2008: K1 and K2 are associated with BMD and fractures.
Витамин K1.how_to_choose: Choose the form according to the purpose: metabolic effects are stronger in K2; K1 - common food phylloquinone; without indications, the benefit has not been proven.
mechs: decrease in HOMA-IR (MA 2024, WMD -0.24), the effect is stronger in K2
decrease in CRP (MA 2019, p=0.01), other factors unchanged
K1 and K2 in bone metabolism
association with BMD and reduction in fractures (2008 review)
Витамин K1.myths: “K1 and K2 are interchangeable” - different forms. “Helps coagulation of all” - effect in newborns. “The supplement will improve bones”—data from dialysis patients. “Needed by everyone” - no data.
Витамин K1.name: Vitamin K1
Витамин K1.onset: The timing of the effect has not been established: in MA 2024, a decrease in HOMA-IR was noted when taking vitamin K as part of the RCT.
Витамин K1.title: Vitamin K1
Витамин K1.who_needs: In case of impaired insulin sensitivity, the effect is small and is stronger in K2 than in K1; in the elderly, for bones - data on K1+K2, primarily MK-4; There is no benefit shown for healthy people.

Витамин K2.about: Osteocalcin γ-carboxylation cofactor: lumbar BMD is higher in postmenopausal osteoporosis.
Витамин K2.caution: Vitamin K2 (menaquinone, MK-7). For osteoporosis in postmenopausal women: systematic reviews are available (36033779, 35711002). For fractures: mixed data (used as a treatment for osteoporosis in Japan). For vascular calcification: limited data. Dose: 45-180 mcg/day. Caution: warfarin (vitamin K antagonist). There is little data (only 5 abstracts).
Витамин K2.food_sources: Natto, cheeses, eggs, meat; fat-soluble - take with fats.
Витамин K2.guidelines: MA 2015–2022: with osteoporosis, BMD is higher; fractures RR 0.43–0.50 only after sensitive analysis; AEs are more common (RR 1.22–1.33).
Витамин K2.how_to_choose: Menaquinone MK-7 45–180 mcg/day with fat; do not start on warfarin; priority - osteoporosis.
mechs: Activates osteocalcin and MGP (Ca into bone, not into blood vessels)
BMD of the lower back and forearm is higher (WMD 2.17/1.57); without osteoporosis there is no effect
uc-OC and uc-OC/cOC are lower, total osteocalcin +26.5; fractures RR 0.43–0.50 only after sensitive analysis
Витамин K2.myths: “Bones for everyone” - without osteoporosis, BMD does not change. “Cleans blood vessels” - there is little data. “Blood is like warfarin” - on the contrary, it is contraindicated with it.
Витамин K2.name: Vitamin K2
Витамин K2.onset: Long-term effect: MIC and uc-OC change over distance; There is no quick “bone strengthening”.
Витамин K2.title: Vitamin K2
Витамин K2.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Витамин K2.who_needs: Postmenopausal women with osteoporosis or low BMD (often with vitamin D); Without osteoporosis there is no effect.

ГАБА.about: Main inhibitory neurotransmitter; oral GABA does not pass the BBB well - sleep/stress is poorly confirmed.
ГАБА.caution: Gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA). A systematic review of 14 placebo-controlled RCTs found: LIMITED evidence for stress, VERY LIMITED for sleep. The main problem: oral GABA does not cross the blood-brain barrier (BBB). The clinical effect is doubtful. The evidence is mixed and the quality of RCTs is often poor.
ГАБА.food_sources: Fermented and fermented foods contain GABA; how much is absorbed into the brain has not been established.
ГАБА.guidelines: SR 2020 (14 placebo-RCT): stress - limited evidence, sleep - very limited; There are no recommendations on dose/course.
ГАБА.how_to_choose: If you try it, 100–300 mg (research doses); You shouldn’t expect any effect - card D.
mechs: Does not pass the BBB: transporter transfer is limited
The claimed dream has not been confirmed
Peripheral mechanisms of stress response to oral GABA
Neuromodulation from the outside without passing the BBB (periphery/vagus nerve)
Sleep: very limited data, not confirmed (SR 2020)
ГАБА.myths: “Calms as a pharmaceutical drug” - limited evidence, some RCT without effect. “Goes to the brain” - the BBB passes the worst.
ГАБА.name: GABA
ГАБА.onset: The effect is unstable: stress is limited, sleep is very limited (SR 2020).
ГАБА.title: GABA
ГАБА.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
ГАБА.who_needs: Undecided: a review of 14 RCTs provided limited evidence for stress and very limited evidence for sleep; healthy no.

Гиалуроновая кислота.about: Polysaccharide of joints and skin; works in the form of injections for arthrosis, there is no data available orally.
Гиалуроновая кислота.caution: Intra-articular injections for knee OA: SMALL effect, and PRP (plasma) is SUPERIOR to HA (LP-PRP MD -10.54 WOMAC). Oral (DS): high-quality RCT with NO outcomes. Cosmetic fillers: rare severe vascular complications (necrosis, loss of vision).
Гиалуроновая кислота.food_sources: You can’t get it from food: there are no working doses of HA in foods; in chicken broth and cartilage the quantities are negligible.
Гиалуроновая кислота.guidelines: Cochrane 2015: HA injections are of little help for ankle arthrosis. MA 2026: PRP is more effective than HA. No oral data available.
Гиалуроновая кислота.how_to_choose: The oral form does not make sense (no data); injections - discuss with your doctor, PRP is more effective according to WOMAC.
mechs: Partially absorbed → dermis and synovial fluid
IV injection: viscoelastic properties in joint fluid
Injection form for knee arthrosis (comparison with PRP)
PRP is better according to WOMAC/VAS (NMA 2026, 42 RCT); GC - active control
Гиалуроновая кислота.myths: “We drink and the joints are lubricated” - RCT does not show any benefit orally. “Better than plasma” - no: PRP is superior to HA according to WOMAC (MA 2026).
Гиалуроновая кислота.name: Hyaluronic Acid
Гиалуроновая кислота.onset: Injections: effect on pain is visible for months (6 months, −12% AOS); Dietary supplement - no effect shown.
Гиалуроновая кислота.title: Hyaluronic Acid
Гиалуроновая кислота.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Гиалуроновая кислота.who_needs: Arthrosis of the knee/ankle (injections); the oral form is only hope for the skin, there is no benefit in RCT.

Гимнема.about: Ayurvedic herb for diabetes. There are RCT (small samples), the effect on glycemia is modest - a decrease in HbA1c by 0.5-1%. Does not replace metformin.
Гимнема.caution: In type 2 diabetes - may increase the effect of metformin/insulin and the risk of hypoglycemia. Sugar monitoring is mandatory. Does not replace therapy. During pregnancy - avoid.
Гимнема.food_sources: It is not used as food - only the leaves of the plant in extract.
Гимнема.guidelines: In Ayurveda, it is a traditional remedy for diabetes. In India it is used as part of drugs. FDA/EFSA does not approve.
Гимнема.how_to_choose: Standardized extract for gymnemic acid 25%+. Check for COA.

interactions.note: risk of hypoglycemia - sugar control is mandatory

mechs: Gymnemic acid: blockade of sweet receptors on the tongue
Decreased perception of sweets and appetite for sugar
Gymnemosides: inhibition of intestinal glucose absorption
Гимнема.myths: “Treats diabetes” - no, only an auxiliary remedy. “Removes cravings for sweets completely” - the effect is moderate in some people.
Гимнема.name: Gymnema
Гимнема.onset: 2-4 weeks for effect on appetite; 8-12 weeks for changes in tests.
Гимнема.title: Gymnema
Гимнема.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. Doses up to 1 g/day are well tolerated.
Гимнема.who_needs: People with prediabetes (HbA1c 5.7-6.4%). For type 2 diabetes - only in addition to therapy, with control. To reduce cravings for sweets.

Гинкго.about: In pathology (dementia, post-stroke), EGb-761 can support cognition; in healthy people there is no effect.
Гинкго.caution: Cochrane reviews on dementia: effect is STATISTICALLY small, NOT clinically significant. For cognitive functions in healthy people there is NO effect. Risk of bleeding (antiplatelet effect) - be careful with anticoagulants. DOES NOT prevent dementia (large RCT GEM, n=3069).
Гинкго.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved. Cochrane: In dementia, effect is modest and inconsistent; in healthy people - not confirmed.

interactions.note: enhances the effect, risk of bleeding

mechs: In healthy people, meta-analyses are negative
Antioxidant activity of the extract: neutralizes free radicals
Fewer manifestations of tardive dyskinesia in patients on antipsychotics
Cognition, activities of daily living and quality of life in dementia and stroke
Гинкго.myths: “Improves memory for everyone” - an effect with age-related decline, not in healthy people. “Safe with aspirin” – risk of bleeding.
Гинкго.name: Ginkgo
Гинкго.onset: Cognitive functions - 12-24 weeks; only for pathology, for healthy people there is no data.
Гинкго.title: Ginkgo
Гинкго.who_needs: Only with confirmed pathology: mild/moderate dementia (adjuvant), ischemic stroke. Healthy people don’t need it.

Глицин.about: Inhibitory amino acid: improves sleep onset (3 g) in selected RCTs; There are no meta-analyses - the base is weak.
Глицин.caution: Glycine is an inhibitory neurotransmitter. There are NO meta-analyses or systematic reviews in the database. Selected RCTs have shown: improvement in sleep quality (3 g at bedtime), adjuvant in schizophrenia (as an adjuvant to antipsychotics), maintenance of collagen synthesis. But there is no systematic assessment of these effects. Popular in biohacking circles, but the evidence base is weak.
Глицин.food_sources: Collagen/gelatin, meat, legumes - rich in glycine; It’s difficult to get a dose of 3 g from food.
Глицин.guidelines: SR 2024: nervous system - most positive effects, but data quality is low; doses 3 g before bedtime, courses up to 4 months.
Глицин.how_to_choose: If you try it, regular glycine 3 g before bedtime; the effect is subjective, you should not expect science (card D).
mechs: Reduction of core body temperature + NMDA co-agonist
GlyNAC in the elderly: GSH reduction, less oxidative stress/inflammation (n=36)
Sleep and psychiatric symptoms with long-term use
Healthy people sleep better; samples are small, risk of bias high (SR 2024)
Глицин.myths: Proven sleep aid - SR 2024: improving sleep in small samples with high risk of bias. “Prolongs life”—an effect in animals, not in humans.
Глицин.name: Glycine
Глицин.onset: Sleep - with a single dose of 3 g before bedtime; in the review courses up to 4 months; no taxonomy.
Глицин.title: Glycine
Глицин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Глицин.who_needs: Unproven: data on sleep and schizophrenia in small samples; biohacker enthusiasts; elderly - GlyNAC experiment (n=36).

Глутамин.about: Conditionally essential amino acid; in intensive care, the effect is controversial; there are no data on outcomes for sports/muscles.
Глутамин.caution: For critical care (ICU, burns): Cochrane shows CLEAR effect - some RCTs are positive, others are not. For prematurity: Cochrane showed no benefit. For sports/immunity after exercise: no systematic data with clinical outcomes. It is safe orally, but the effect is questionable outside the ICU.
effects: Muscles: not confirmed; gut/immunity - only in the clinic
Глутамин.food_sources: Red meat, poultry, fish, milk, yogurt, legumes are the main sources; With normal nutrition there is no deficiency.
Глутамин.guidelines: 2024 MA (clinical): benefit is controversial and varies by group; 2024 MA (perioperative immunonutrition): complications below. Healthy people - no effect.
Глутамин.how_to_choose: Not necessary for healthy people with adequate nutrition; In the clinic, use medications as prescribed by your doctor, not dietary supplements.
mechs: Conditionally essential: fuel of enterocytes and lymphocytes
Muscles: not confirmed; gut/immunity - only in the clinic
Early RCT: fewer infections; 2 large RCTs did not confirm benefit (Cochrane 2014)
Metabolic fuel of enterocytes and lymphocytes in newborns
Prematures: no difference in infections and weight gain (Cochrane 2001)
Глутамин.myths: “Conditionally irreplaceable = everyone” - the clinical benefit is controversial (2024 MA). “For muscles” - no RCT.
Глутамин.name: Glutamine
Глутамин.onset: There is no immediate effect; in the clinic for days to weeks, the benefit was not confirmed in large RCTs.
Глутамин.title: Glutamine
Глутамин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Глутамин.who_needs: Only in the clinic as conditionally indispensable in critical conditions (as prescribed); healthy - not indicated, no benefit.

Глутатион.about: The main intracellular antioxidant. The problem is poor absorption when taken orally. NAC works indirectly - as a predecessor.
Глутатион.caution: Oral glutathione is poorly absorbed—most is destroyed in the GI. The liposomal form is better. IV glutathione - only in the clinic (used in cosmetology, but its effectiveness in skin whitening has not been confirmed). Avoid during pregnancy without advice.
Глутатион.course: 8-12 weeks; the effect orally is weak
Глутатион.food_sources: In food - as part of proteins (meat, fish, avocado, asparagus). The body synthesizes it itself - in the absence of a deficiency, supplements are useless.
Глутатион.guidelines: EFSA does not approve health claims. In clinical medicine - IV for poisoning, paracetamol hepatitis.
Глутатион.how_to_choose: Liposomal glutathione (better bioavailability) or NAC (as a precursor, cheaper and more effective).
mechs: Primary cell antioxidant: neutralizes free radicals
Support of glutathione pool in lymphocytes
Глутатион.myths: “Skin whitens” is a popular myth in Asia, no RCT. “Improves everything” is an exaggeration. NAC often works better and is cheaper.
Глутатион.name: Glutathione
Глутатион.onset: 4-8 weeks for changes in tests (blood levels); on health - not noticeable.
Глутатион.title: Glutathione
Глутатион.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. Doses up to 2 g/day are well tolerated.
Глутатион.who_needs: People with oxidative stress (chronic diseases, smoking). For HIV, diabetes, liver disease - deficiency. In cosmetology - intravenously for “whitening” (the effect has not been confirmed by RCT).

Глюкозамин + хондроитин.about: Cartilage substrates for osteoarthritis; the effect is small, close to placebo; chondroitin is a little stronger.
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.caution: CHONDROITIN works better than glucosamine. The effect is small but clinically significant (NNT=5). RCT quality is mostly LOW. Glucosamine sulfate works better than hydrochloride. There were fewer serious adverse events than placebo (Peto OR 0.40).
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.food_sources: Bone broths, cartilage, shrimp; You can’t get working doses from food - it’s easier to take a supplement.
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.guidelines: 2025 SR (safety): profile acceptable; 2023 MA (knee): chondroitin - short-term benefit, glucosamine ≈ placebo (except Rotta).
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.how_to_choose: Chondroitin 1200 mg or glucosamine sulfate 1500 mg (not hydrochloride); course 3–6 months; no effect - quit.

interactions.note: may enhance the effect, INR control

mechs: Cartilage matrix substrate; MA are inconsistent
Chondroitin: short-term effect on OA pain
Pain in the first 6 months is lower (10%); long-term effects without confirmation (43 RCT)
VAS is marginally lower; WOMAC is insignificant, only the Rotta drug is better (20 RCT to 2005)
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.myths: “Restores cartilage” - regeneration has not been proven in RCT. “Acts like ibuprofen” - the effect is small and close to placebo, wears off after a year.
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.name: Glucosamine + Chondroitin
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.onset: Course effect: pain is lower in the first 6 months, by the year the effect wears off (43 RCT).
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.title: Glucosamine + Chondroitin
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.who_needs: Knee arthrosis: modest pain relief in the first months; in case of severe wear and tear and obesity, it is not a replacement for treatment.

Готу кола.about: Centella: cognition = placebo; cheerfulness is higher, anger is lower; wound healing - 4 RCT.
Готу кола.caution: Gotu kola (Centella asiatica) is an adaptogen from Ayurveda. For cognitive function: there is evidence, but the quality of RCT is often low. For venous insufficiency: data available. Safe in standard doses (60-240 mg/day). Caution: Hepatotoxicity in rare cases.
Готу кола.food_sources: The leaves of Centella asiatica are eaten as greens in Asia; clinical doses are from a standardized extract.
Готу кола.guidelines: MA 2017 (5 RCT): cognition = placebo; cheerfulness SMD 0.71, anger −0.81 (1 hour). SR 2022: healing - 4 RCT.
Готу кола.how_to_choose: Extract with standardization for triterpenes (asiaticoside), 300-600 mg in courses; If you have liver problems, do not take it.
mechs: Triterpenes (asiaticoside): microcirculation and venous tone, weak GABA modulation
Venous insufficiency is moderate; cognition/sleep—weak data
Mood modulation: cheerfulness and reduction of irritability
Cheerfulness is higher (SMD 0.71), anger is lower (−0.81) after 1 hour; cognition without effect
Angiogenesis and collagen I synthesis (wound healing)
Healing: angiogenesis via collagen I/FGF/VEGF; 4 RCT without meta-analysis
Готу кола.myths: Nootropic herb - no difference from placebo in all domains of cognition. “Heals wounds from the inside” - 4 small RCTs without meta-analysis. Rare hepatotoxicity.
Готу кола.name: Gotu Kola
Готу кола.onset: After 1 hour, cheerfulness is higher and anger is lower; There is no cognitive benefit even with the course.
Готу кола.title: Gotu Kola
Готу кола.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Готу кола.who_needs: Venous insufficiency and swelling; fatigue/irritability (energy after 1 hour); wound healing - course.

Гуперзин А.about: Acetylcholinesterase inhibitor: better for Alzheimer's, but weak data; MCI has not been studied.
Гуперзин А.caution: Huperzine A is an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor from the club moss plant (Chinese medicine). There are 3 Cochrane reviews: for Alzheimer's disease, vascular dementia and mild cognitive impairment. There is some effectiveness, but it is comparable to other AChE inhibitors (donepezil). Side effects: cholinergic (nausea, bradycardia). Caution: bradycardia, asthma, obstructive pulmonary disease.
Гуперзин А.food_sources: The club moss (Huperzia serrata) is not food; The supplement is a standardized plant extract.
Гуперзин А.guidelines: 2024 network MA (vascular dementia): effect; 2022 umbrella (BA): cognition is better in small RCTs. UKN: No RCT.
Гуперзин А.how_to_choose: H. serrata extract 50-200 mcg in cycles, not for asthma/bradycardia, not with cholinergic drugs.
mechs: Reversible acetylcholinesterase inhibitor (Huperzia serrata) → acetylcholine at synapses
Memory in dementia (used in China); healthy people have a weak, narrow window of safety
Neuroprotection: protection against beta-amyloid, glutamate, peroxide
BA: cognitive benefit from small RCTs, quality weak (Cochrane 2008)
Claimed use in vascular dementia and MCI
Vascular dementia: 1 RCT (14 people), MMSE WMD 2.40 ns; no RCT for UKN
Гуперзин А.myths: “Pumps up the brain of a healthy person” - RCT only for dementia. “It will save you from MCI” - no RCT. “Safe in any dose” - cholinergic side effects.
Гуперзин А.name: Huperzine A
Гуперзин А.onset: For course dementia (weeks or longer); does not provide acute “clarity” to a healthy person.
Гуперзин А.title: Huperzine A
Гуперзин А.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Гуперзин А.who_needs: Elderly with dementia - as prescribed by a doctor (used in China); healthy for the “brain” - no data; UKN without RCT.

Ежовик.about: Edible mushroom: neurogenesis and cognition - in vitro and in animals; on people 1 RCT + pilot, the base is small.
Ежовик.caution: Hericium erinaceus (lion's mane). The only abstract in the database is an overview of potential properties. There are VERY few high-quality RCTs on cognitive function in humans. The main data are preclinical. Not to be confused with nootropic effects without evidence base.
Ежовик.food_sources: Edible mushroom (fresh or dried); clinical doses and forms have not been determined.
Ежовик.guidelines: No recommendations: SR 2025 (PMID 40959699) - 5 RCT + 3 pilots, modest data; side effects - GI and allergies.
Ежовик.how_to_choose: There is no standard: take an edible mushroom, not an “extract with neurogenesis”; Allergy sufferers be careful.
mechs: People do not have stable RCTs
Cognitive performance in dementia: MMSE shift
MMSE +1.17 in a team of 1 RCT + 1 pilot; the base is tiny
Microbiota: increasing diversity and SCFA producers
Gut microbiota up, SCFA more; clinical significance not shown
Ежовик.myths: “Mushroom nootropic” - in people 1 RCT + pilot (MMSE +1.17). "Neurogenesis" - BDNF/NGF in vitro and in mice. “Harmless” - GI discomfort and allergies.
Ежовик.name: Lion's Mane
Ежовик.onset: Coursework and weak: MMSE +1.17 after long-term use; no acute effect has been described.
Ежовик.title: Lion's Mane
Ежовик.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Ежовик.who_needs: Elderly with cognitive complaints - base of 1 RCT + 1 pilot; healthy has not been proven; doses are from animal studies only.

Железо.about: Hemoglobin cofactor: works for anemia and ferritin deficiency; at normal levels there is no benefit.
Железо.caution: The effect depends on the INITIAL ferritin level. Healthy people with normal Fe have little benefit. In case of anemia or deficiency - significant. GI side effects (constipation, nausea) are frequent. Pregnancy: WHO routine recommendation.
Железо.food_sources: Red meat (heme - better absorbed); vegetable and tannins (tea) are worse. You can't get enough food if there's a shortage.
Железо.guidelines: WHO - routine during pregnancy; in case of deficiency, courses and under the control of ferritin. Cochrane: anemia RR 0.30 (0.20–0.47).
Железо.how_to_choose: Start with ferritin/OAC only. Don’t push the form: choose the one that is tolerable - GI side effects decide.
mechs: Heme/ferritin: O2 transport; tyrosine hydroxylase cofactor
Replenishment of hemoglobin and ferritin in case of deficiency/anemia
Anemia during pregnancy: RR 0.30 (0.20–0.47); Ferritin is normal
Restoration of O2 transport and neurotransmission in anemia
Physical performance and cognition in deficit (2016)
Effective for lower GI AEs (nausea/constipation) vs daily (2011)
Железо.myths: “More - more energetic” - there is no benefit at normal ferritin levels. “Only daily” - 1–3 r/week softer. “Tea cancels everything” - it only reduces absorption.
Железо.name: Iron
Железо.onset: Ferritin and hemoglobin increase over 4–12 weeks; the 1–3 r/week scheme is gentler on GI.
Железо.title: Iron
Железо.who_needs: Menstruating women, pregnant women (WHO), vegans/vegetarians and anyone deficient in ferritin - order by analysis.

Женьшень.about: Ginseng: improves memory (MA 2024 SMD 0.19, high doses 0.33), attention and cognition do not change; American ginseng—fatigue in cancer therapy (ASCO 2024).
Женьшень.caution: Safety data in healthy subjects is limited; in case of cancer - coordinate with the oncologist; in healthy people the effect is small.
Женьшень.course: According to RCT schemes (usually weeks-months), incl. during cancer therapy for fatigue.
Женьшень.food_sources: Ginseng is a root, not a food product; used in the form of extracts, powders and teas; tradition - East Asia (Panax ginseng).
Женьшень.guidelines: MA 2024 (15 RCT, n=671): memory SMD 0.19, high dose 0.33; ASCO-SIO 2024: American ginseng - for fatigue, low-moderate confidence; adaptogens: chronic fatigue.
Женьшень.how_to_choose: Panax ginseng (Asian) - for memory; American ginseng (Panax quinquefolius) - for fatigue in cancer therapy; standardized extracts, doses according to research schemes.
mechs: Taking ginseng preparations for memory impairment
resistance to stress without increasing oxygen consumption, historical use
Женьшень.myths: “Ginseng improves all thinking” - MA: memory yes, attention and executive functions no. “Any ginseng is the same” - fatigue has been studied in American. “Adaptogens are good for everyone”—the data for healthy people is weak.
Женьшень.name: Ginseng
Женьшень.onset: Course: effect on memory in MA 2024 when taking ginseng preparations in RCT; for fatigue - for the duration of therapy according to the ASCO scheme.
Женьшень.title: Ginseng
Женьшень.who_needs: For memory impairment, the effect is significant, higher at high doses (SMD 0.33); during cancer therapy - American ginseng for fatigue (ASCO recommendation); in healthy people the effect is small.

Зверобой.about: Hyperforin blocks serotonin reuptake: works for mild depression, comparable to SSRIs.
Зверобой.caution: For mild-moderate depression: comparable effectiveness to SSRI, BUT fewer side effects. DOES NOT work for severe depression/suicidality. CRITICAL: interaction with drugs (CYP3A4 inducer) - reduces the effectiveness of oral contraceptives, anticoagulants, antiretrovirals, immunosuppressants. Photosensitivity.
Зверобой.food_sources: In pharmacies there is herb for tea, but the working doses are a standardized extract; you cannot get them with tea.
Зверобой.guidelines: 2023 MA (vs SSRI): parity in response and remission; 2021 SR: CYP3A4 inducer, interaction with warfarin. Mild to moderate depression only.
Зверобой.how_to_choose: Extract 300 mg 3 times a day (0.3% hypericin), course 4-6 weeks; check for drug interactions.
mechs: Mild depression; induction of CYP3A4 - interactions!
Comparability with SSRIs: response and remission
Response/remission comparable to SSRIs (RR ~1.0), dropout lower (OR 0.59); 27 RCT, 3808
Safety limitations: severe depression and duration
Data is only 4-12 weeks; There is no evidence for severe depression and suicidality
Зверобой.myths: “Treats severe depression” - mild/moderate only. "Safe Herb" - CYP3A4 inducer: reduces contraceptives and anticoagulants.
Зверобой.name: St. John's Wort
Зверобой.onset: Effect by 4-12 weeks, noticeable from 2-4 weeks; data is only short-term.
Зверобой.title: St. John's Wort
Зверобой.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Зверобой.who_needs: Mild to moderate depression, when you want to avoid the side effects of SSRIs; Contraindicated in severe depression and suicidality.

Имбирь.about: Anti-inflammatory, antiemetic, moderate effect on pain.
Имбирь.caution: Ginger (Zingiber officinale). For nausea in pregnancy: systematic reviews support effectiveness (dose 1 g/day). For postoperative nausea: data available. For glycemic control in type 2 diabetes: moderate improvement. For inflammation/oxidative stress: data available. Safe in doses up to 4 g/day. Caution: anticoagulants (antiplatelet effect).
effects: Nausea (pregnancy, motion sickness, chemo): works (not confirmed)
Имбирь.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved; MA has a moderate effect on pain in osteoarthritis.
Имбирь.how_to_choose: Standardization of 5% gingerols; capsules or fresh root.
mechs: Gingerols: modulation of 5-HT3 and GI motility
Prevention of postoperative nausea and vomiting
Vomiting after surgery: ginger oil RR 0.39; nausea without clear benefit (18 RCT)
T2D: glucose −18.8, HbA1c −0.57%, blood pressure lower; lipids unchanged (10 RCT)
Имбирь.myths: “Cures a cold” - relieves symptoms, does not cure. “Safe with anticoagulants” - risk of bleeding.
Имбирь.name: Ginger
Имбирь.title: Ginger
Имбирь.who_needs: Osteoarthritis, nausea during pregnancy, postoperative vomiting, muscle pain.

Инозитол.about: Insulin signal mediator: gestational diabetes less common (RR 0.42); PCOS - live birth not proven.
Инозитол.caution: For PCOS: may reduce miscarriages, BUT the data is VERY LOW quality. No effect was shown for live births (OR 2.42, CI crosses 1). For gestational diabetes: a preventive effect is possible, but data are limited. NOT a replacement for metformin.
Инозитол.food_sources: Cereals, corn, legumes, and meat contain myo-inositol; doses of 2–4 g from food are unattainable.
Инозитол.guidelines: Umbrella-MA 2026 (19 studies, 17,932): HDM RR 0.42, preterm birth RR 0.38; quality is VERY LOW.
Инозитол.how_to_choose: Myo-inositol 2–4 g/day – research doses; for PCOS and HDM only with a doctor, carefully with lithium.
mechs: Second messenger of insulin and 5-HT receptors
Gestational diabetes: RR 0.42; insulin therapy RR 0.33; preterm births lower (17,932)
PCOS: ovulation is higher, insulin resistance is better; quality of evidence is limited (Cochrane 2018)
Инозитол.myths: “Guarantees pregnancy” - Cochrane: no effect on live birth (OR crosses 1). “Instead of metformin” - no, adjuvant.
Инозитол.name: Inositol
Инозитол.onset: GDM prophylaxis from 10–24 weeks of pregnancy; with PCOS, the effect is assessed over months of use.
Инозитол.title: Inositol
Инозитол.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Инозитол.who_needs: Pregnant women at risk of gestational diabetes; PCOS with insulin resistance; does not replace metformin.

Йод.about: Iodine is a trace element for the thyroid gland; in the selection of abstracts there are no positive MA specifically for iodine supplements; there is data on iodine restriction in Hashimoto’s.
Йод.caution: Excess iodine can worsen thyroiditis; for diseases of the thyroid gland - medical supervision; Without a deficiency, supplementation is not justified.
Йод.course: Not established: There is no data on the effectiveness of additives in the abstracts.
Йод.dosage: The dosages of iodine dietary supplements are not given in the abstracts.
Йод.food_sources: Seafood, fish, seaweed, iodized salt, dairy products; Content depends on region and soil.
Йод.guidelines: ESPEN 2022: assessment of status and prescription of microelements for deficiency; SR 2023 (Hashimoto): iodine restriction had no effect; There are no positive MAs for iodine supplements in the selection.
Йод.how_to_choose: Take only with a confirmed deficiency as prescribed by a doctor; dose and form - according to status; for diseases of the thyroid gland - a special scheme.
mechs: supporting thyroid function in case of deficiency
Iodine in the diet for Hashimoto's thyroiditis
Assessment of trace element status in the clinic
Deficiencies are significant in acute and chronic diseases (ESPEN 2022)
Йод.myths: “More iodine means better thyroid” - in a 2023 review, a diet with iodine restriction did not show any effect. “Everyone needs iodine” - supplementation is logical only if there is an established deficiency. “Iodine is harmless” - excess iodine affects the gland.
Йод.name: Iodine
Йод.onset: No data: the timing of the effect of iodine dietary supplements is not described in abstracts.
Йод.title: Iodine
Йод.who_needs: Correction of iodine deficiency - based on nutritional status (ESPEN emphasizes the importance of deficiencies); for Hashimoto's, reducing iodine had no effect; healthy without data deficiency there is no.

Йохимбин.about: Alpha-2 blocker: there is an effect for ED (old MA), but the price is blood pressure, pulse, impulsivity.
Йохимбин.caution: Yohimbine (alpha-2 adrenergic blocker) from Pausinystalia yohimbe. Historically used for erectile dysfunction. The FDA approved it in the 1990s, but research stopped after Viagra was introduced in 1998. There are NO contemporary systematic reviews. Serious side effects: tachycardia, anxiety, increased blood pressure. Interacts with many medications. In the EU and Canada it is prohibited as a dietary supplement. Not recommended without medical supervision.
effects: Fat burning is weak, the price is side effects
Йохимбин.food_sources: The bark of the Pausinystalia yohimbe tree is not food; Its “yohimbe” extracts are prohibited in a number of countries outside of pharmacies.
Йохимбин.guidelines: MA 1998 (7 RCT, ED): OR 3.85 vs placebo; There are no current reviews. RCT 2022 (n=18): Sprint is better. The side effects are significant.
Йохимбин.how_to_choose: Start 2.5 mg, maximum 10 mg, with a doctor and blood pressure/pulse monitoring; not with antidepressants; prohibited in EU/Canada.
mechs: Fat burning is weak, the price is side effects
ED: OR 3.85 vs placebo (MA 1998, 7 RCT); Serious AEs are rare and reversible
Alpha-2 blockade + adrenaline: lipolysis during exercise
Fat% 9.3→7.1 over 21 days in football players, no strength gain (1 RCT, n=20)
Йохимбин.myths: “Burn fat” - one RCT (n=20), no strength. “Safe” - tachycardia, blood pressure, impulsivity; It is prohibited as a dietary supplement in the EU/Canada.
Йохимбин.name: Yohimbine
Йохимбин.onset: Acute: 2.5 mg over 20 minutes - ergogenic shifts; course: fat% lower in 21 days (n=20).
Йохимбин.title: Yohimbine
Йохимбин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Йохимбин.who_needs: Only under medical supervision: for ED (old data); fat burning/sprinting - single RCT; not for self-medication.

Калий.about: Potassium lowers blood pressure, more so in hypertensive patients, but the relationship is U-shaped: with excess potassium, pressure, on the contrary, increases.
Калий.caution: Excess potassium increased blood pressure in patients on antihypertensive drugs; for cystinuria, hydration and alkalization without graduation are recommended.
Калий.course: RCTs in MA lasted from 4 weeks; the optimal period is not specified in the abstracts.
Калий.dosage: In MA the range is 30-140 mmol/day; Specific dosage regimens are not given in the abstracts.
Калий.food_sources: Bananas, potatoes, beans, spinach and dairy products; in the pool, potassium is considered both as food and as a supplement in doses of 30-140 mmol/day.
Калий.guidelines: For cystinuria (2021): hydration, diet and alkalization; statements are not graded due to low evidence. ESPEN 2022 - by consensus.
Калий.how_to_choose: The source is more important than dietary supplements: MA examined doses of 30-140 mmol/day, and self-administration is dangerous for blood pressure medications and kidney diseases.

interactions.note: in MA, an increase in blood pressure with high potassium excretion was observed only in patients on drug therapy

mechs: Dose-dependent relationship: reduction in blood pressure to a difference of 30 mmol/day, then the effect weakens
Decrease in systolic and diastolic blood pressure
U-shaped relationship: above ~80 mmol/day excretion, blood pressure increases, especially with drug treatment
Increase in blood pressure with excess potassium
The decrease in blood pressure from potassium is stronger in hypertensive patients and with high sodium intake
Greater effect in subgroups with hypertension
Калий.myths: “Potassium tablets = diet” - part of the data concerns high-potassium salt, not dietary supplements. “The more, the better” - an increase in blood pressure already with a difference in excretion above ~80 mmol/day. “Helps everyone” - stronger in hypertensive patients.
Калий.name: Potassium
Калий.onset: Only RCTs lasting 4 weeks or more are included in the MA; a shorter course is not stated in abstracts.
Калий.title: Potassium
Калий.upper_limit: not listed in abstracts; MA indicates an increase in blood pressure with an excretion difference above ~80 mmol/day
Калий.who_needs: People with hypertension and high sodium intake. During drug therapy for blood pressure, excess potassium, on the contrary, increased it in MA.

Кальций.about: Macromineral: bone mineralization, vascular tone; Without deficiency it is useless, it works in pregnancy.
Кальций.caution: Effect in pregnancy: High doses ≥1 g/day reduce preeclampsia, especially when dietary Ca is LOW. The risk of HELLP syndrome is increased (RR 2.67, but absolutely rare). Outside of pregnancy: prevention of fractures with vitamin D only.
effects: Fractures: MA inconsistent; without deficit it is useless
Кальций.food_sources: Dairy products, sesame seeds, greens, fish with bones; absorption depends on vitamin D.
Кальций.guidelines: Cochrane 2018: ≥1 g/d in pregnancy reduces preeclampsia. For bone - 500–600 mg + D; Without deficit there is no benefit.
Кальций.how_to_choose: First food (milk/sesame); supplement 500–600 mg + vitamin D. Carbonate or citrate - as tolerated.

interactions.note: reduces absorption, separate doses for 2-4 hours

mechs: Fractures: MA inconsistent; without deficit it is useless
Calcium in pregnancy: regulation of vascular tone
BP is up less often (RR 0.65), preeclampsia is lower (≥1 g/d; 15,730)
The effect of calcium on blood pressure in normotensive patients (primary prevention)
Small shifts in blood pressure; preventive benefit not established (Cochrane 2022)
Кальций.myths: “The more, the better” - without a deficiency, it does not prevent fractures. “Reduces blood pressure for everyone” - the effect is small in normotensive patients (Cochrane 2022).
Кальций.name: Calcium
Кальций.onset: Preeclampsia: courses during pregnancy; on bone - months or years, and only with vitamin D.
Кальций.title: Calcium
Кальций.who_needs: Pregnant women with low dietary Ca (≥1 g/d reduces preeclampsia); elderly with deficiency - be sure to take vitamin D.

Карнозин.about: There are no direct MAs for carnosine - only data through the precursor β-alanine (increases muscle carnosine and performance), the effect is indirect.
Карнозин.caution: β-alanine increases the risk of paresthesia (OR 8.9, MA 2019); ALT is slightly higher, but within normal limits; There is little safety data for carnosine itself.
Карнозин.food_sources: Carnosine is found in meat, poultry, fish (especially beef); β-alanine - in muscle tissue of animals.
Карнозин.guidelines: MA 2017 (40 studies, n=1461): overall ES 0.18, exercises 0.5-10 min - 0.50; SR 2025: 4-6.4 g/day in fractions, 5-8 weeks; risk analysis 2019: paresthesia OR 8.9, ALT within normal limits.
Карнозин.how_to_choose: If the goal is performance, consider β-alanine (fractional doses of 4-6.4 g/day); The carnosine supplement itself has been less studied.
mechs: Increasing muscle carnosine due to β-alanine
Buffering of H+ ions during high-intensity work
best effect on strength and power at 4-6.4 g/day (SR 2025)
Карнозин.myths: “Carnosine = β-alanine” is a precursor, related but different substances. “Quick effect” - weeks of accumulation are needed. “Paresthesia is a sign of performance” is a side effect of β-alanine (OR 8.9), not carnosine directly.
Карнозин.name: Carnosine
Карнозин.onset: After several weeks of accumulation: β-alanine 4-6.4 g/day 5-8 weeks (SR 2025); For carnosine itself, the timing has not been established.
Карнозин.title: Carnosine
Карнозин.who_needs: High-intensity athletes - data via β-alanine precursor (exercise capacity 0.5-10 min, ES 0.50); There is little direct data on carnosine supplementation itself.

Кверцетин.about: Flavonoid: moderately reduces systolic blood pressure; the effect on endurance is trivial.
Кверцетин.caution: Quercetin is a flavonoid from onions/apples. For blood pressure: a meta-analysis (35948195) shows a moderate decrease. For cardiometabolic factors: improvement of markers (umbrella review 37654199). For endurance: data available (22805526). For hyperuricemia/gout: data available (41514376). Bioavailability is low - forms with enhancers (piperine, phospholipids) are needed. Dose: 500-1000 mg/day.
effects: Allergy/ARI: not confirmed in humans (not confirmed)
Кверцетин.food_sources: Onions, apples, tea, capers; bioavailability is low - working dose from the supplement.
Кверцетин.guidelines: Umbrella 2023 (5 MA): SBP −1.9 mm, insulin −1.07; MA 2022: SBP −2.4, in (pre)hypertensive patients DBP −3.1.
Кверцетин.how_to_choose: 500–1000 mg/day with piperine (bioavailability); with pressure - not instead of, but along with treatment.
mechs: SBP −1.9–2.4 mmHg; DBP only in (pre)hyper. subgroup −3.1
BO2max +1.9%, EP +0.7%; “trivial” for trained and untrained (n=288)
Кверцетин.myths: “Treats allergies” - stabilization of mast cells only in vitro. “Increases endurance” - BO2max +1.9%, but “trivial” for amateurs (MA 2013).
Кверцетин.name: Quercetin
Кверцетин.onset: Effect on blood pressure - course, weeks of admission; There is no ergogenic “at a time”.
Кверцетин.title: Quercetin
Кверцетин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Кверцетин.who_needs: Increased SBP as a mild supplement; hyperuricemia/gout - data available; Allergy/ARI - no.

Клюква.about: Cranberries and UTIs: prevention of relapses in women - minus 26%; treatment - no RCT; the effect is limited.
Клюква.caution: Cranberry (Vaccinium macrocarpon). For the prevention of urinary tract infections: Previously considered effective (proanthocyanidins prevent bacterial adhesion), but current meta-analyses show limited effectiveness. For pressure: data are very limited. There is little data (only 2 abstracts in the database).
effects: Recurrence of UTI: −30% in risk groups
Клюква.food_sources: Berries and unsweetened fruit drinks are PAC; store-bought “juice” is diluted - PAC is not enough.
Клюква.guidelines: Cochrane 2023 (50 RCT, 8857): reduces UTI in groups, confidence low. MA 2017 (7, n=1498): RR 0.74. Treatment - no.
Клюква.how_to_choose: Concentrate with PAC ~36 mg/day (juice without sugar); course for relapses; If you have symptoms, see a doctor.
mechs: PACs block E. coli adhesion to the urothelium
Recurrence of UTI: −30% in risk groups
Treatment of bacterial cystitis: no effect (review of dogs and cats, 122 animals)
Клюква.myths: “Treats cystitis” - Cochrane 2023: RCT no. “Prevention for all” - mainly women with relapses. “Any juice” - you need PAC, the fruit drink is diluted.
Клюква.name: Cranberry
Клюква.onset: Course prophylaxis: effect - for months; not “juice for cystitis”; if you have symptoms, call a doctor.
Клюква.title: Cranberry
Клюква.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Клюква.who_needs: Women with recurrent UTIs (RR 0.74)—modest effect; not for treatment and not for the elderly/with a catheter - limited data.

Коллаген.about: Structural protein: skin, joints, bones. Peptides are absorbed.
Коллаген.caution: Hydrolyzed collagen 2.5-10 g/day, 8-24 weeks. The effect on the skin is significant, but the quality of RCT is often low (high risk of bias). For joints (OA): data are conflicting. Safe, no serious side effects. Optimally: hydrolyzate or peptides (not native collagen).
Коллаген.food_sources: Bone broth, animal skin, gelatin; additives = hydrolyzate (peptides).
forms: hydrolyzate or peptides are not “edible gelatin”; type I/III - skin
Коллаген.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved; series MA - moderate effect on the skin and joints.
Коллаген.how_to_choose: Hydrolyzate (peptides), not gelatin; types I+III (skin), II (joints); with vitamin C.
mechs: Elasticity of skin, joints under load
Saturation of the dermis with peptides: hydration, elasticity, wrinkles
Skin: elasticity, hydration, wrinkle depth better (RCT 1125 and 805 people)
Substrate for healing: density and renewal of the dermis
Wound healing and dermal density: positive, preliminary data
Коллаген.myths: “Gelatin is equivalent” - peptides are absorbed better. “Works immediately” - 8-12 weeks minimum.
Коллаген.name: Collagen
Коллаген.title: Collagen
Коллаген.upper_limit: 15 g/day is safe; higher - GI discomfort.

Кордицепс.about: TCM fungus: CKD has lower creatinine/proteinuria; Metabolism is better after transplantation.
Кордицепс.caution: Cordyceps sinensis is a mushroom from traditional Chinese medicine. For CKD: 2 Cochrane reviews (25519252, 26457607) show improvement in renal function as an adjuvant to standard therapy. For kidney transplant recipients: data available. For endurance: limited data (individual RCTs, not systematically compiled). For pulmonary diseases: limited data. Expensive drug, often counterfeited.
effects: VO2: weak in the elderly, none in athletes
Кордицепс.food_sources: Not food: mushroom, TCM raw materials; the drug is expensive and often counterfeited - there is no food source.
Кордицепс.guidelines: 2024 MA (lung cancer): adjuvant - QoL better; 2024 MA (COPD, Bailing): lung function is higher. Standardization of form is critical.
Кордицепс.how_to_choose: 1-3 g/day of standardized mushroom, with quality control; for CKD/transplantation - only with a doctor.
mechs: VO2: weak in the elderly, none in athletes
Reduction of creatinine and proteinuria in CKD (not on dialysis)
CKD: creatinine −61 µmol/l, clearance +9.2; RCT quality is poor
Adjuvant to immunosuppression after kidney transplantation
Rejection = azathioprine, but nephrotoxicity and metabolism are better (2017)
Кордицепс.myths: “Sports ergogenics” - RCTs for endurance are single, not systematized. “It will cure the kidneys on its own” - only an adjuvant, the quality of RCT is weak.
Кордицепс.name: Cordyceps
Кордицепс.onset: Coursework: markers are better during CKD therapy; after transplantation the effect is 6-12 months.
Кордицепс.title: Cordyceps
Кордицепс.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Кордицепс.who_needs: CKD without dialysis (adjuvant, with a doctor); kidney transplant recipients (not in place of immunosuppression); sport is not justified.

Кофеин.about: Adenosine receptor antagonist: vigor, endurance; the most proven stimulant.
Кофеин.caution: Half-life is 5-6 hours (in 30% of people - 9-10 hours). After 14:00 - sleep disturbance. Safe up to 400 mg/day. Pregnancy: up to 200 mg. CYP1A2 slow metabolizers are more sensitive. Teenagers: caution.
Кофеин.guidelines: EFSA: 400 mg/day safe; ISSN position: ergogenic 3-6 mg/kg.
Кофеин.how_to_choose: Tablets for precise dose before training; in coffee the dose varies (espresso 60-80 mg).
mechs: Antagonism of adenosine A1/A2A receptors → dopamine/NA without inhibition
Blockade of adenosine receptors reduces perceived fatigue during aerobic exercise
Better results in time trials (cycling, running)
Counteraction of sleepiness through adenosine receptors in wakefulness structures
Fewer errors, higher alertness during sleep deprivation and shift work
Кофеин.myths: “Coffee dehydrates” - moderate diuresis does not lead to dehydration. “After 18:00 everyone is allowed” - the CYP1A2 genotype decides, sleep suffers even without sensations.
Кофеин.name: Caffeine
Кофеин.onset: 30-60 minutes, peak 1-2 hours; half-life is 5-6 hours (longer for some).
Кофеин.title: Caffeine
Кофеин.upper_limit: EFSA: single 200 mg, up to 400 mg/day; pregnancy - 200 mg/day.
Кофеин.who_needs: Sports for endurance and strength; night shifts; sleep deprivation (caution).

Креатин.about: Most Researched Sports Supplement: Helps muscles recapture ATP, the currency of short, powerful efforts.
Креатин.caution: The ONLY proven form is CREATINE MONOHYDRATE. HCl/ester/buffer - marketing. Long-term safe in healthy people (ISSN). The myth about the kidneys has been debunked. Water retention of 0.5-2 kg in the first weeks is normal.
Креатин.food_sources: Red meat and fish: about 4-5 g per kilogram of raw product - difficult to get enough of.
Креатин.guidelines: ISSN position: effective and safe; EFSA health claims for sports are not required.
Креатин.how_to_choose: Monohydrate (Creapure sign); without “transport systems” and overpayments for exotic forms.

interactions.note: risk of dehydration, drink more water
load on the kidneys with long-term use

mechs: Phosphocreatine buffer: ATP resynthesis in neurons and muscles
Brain energy metabolism: replenishment of brain stores of creatine phosphate for neurons
Creatine phosphate reserve in high intensity sets: more working repetitions
Increase in lean mass and strength in conjunction with strength training
Креатин.myths: “It hits the kidneys in healthy people” - not confirmed at standard doses. “It doesn’t work without loading” - it works, it’s just slower.
Креатин.name: Creatine
Креатин.onset: 2-4 weeks of regular use (with a loading period of 5-7 days); does not give an instant “tide”.
Креатин.title: Creatine
Креатин.upper_limit: There is no formal UL; 3-5 g/day is safe for a long time; above 10 g/day - GI discomfort.
Креатин.who_needs: Strength and sprint athletes; vegetarians and vegans (there is less creatine in muscles without meat); elderly – against loss of muscle mass.

Кремний.about: Silicon for bones: the only umbrella review - effect on bone metabolism mainly in animals; The threshold of effect achievable in humans has not been determined.
Кремний.caution: There is little data on the safety of supplements; excess microelements are not indicated; In the review, many regimens exceed the norm of 25 mg/day.
Кремний.food_sources: Whole grains, vegetables, root vegetables, bananas, drinking water; Product specifics are not provided in the abstracts.
Кремний.guidelines: Umbrella review 2024 (Nutrients): effect threshold ~139 mg Si/kg/day - unrealistic for humans; Recommendations for supplements are not formulated.
Кремний.how_to_choose: There is no data for choosing a form; if you are interested in silicon, use food sources instead of dietary supplements; The effectiveness of supplements has not been confirmed.
mechs: The effect of silicon on bone and mineral metabolism
in animal studies positive effect at high doses
Translation of results from animals to humans
threshold ~139 mg/kg/day is unlikely to be achievable in humans
Кремний.myths: “Silicon strengthens everyone’s bones” – 2024 survey data mainly from animals. “Effective dose achievable”—the threshold of ~139 mg/kg/day is unrealistic for humans. “The only review is proven” - people have little data.
Кремний.name: Silicon
Кремний.onset: Not established: The review did not determine the effective dose and timing of effect in humans.
Кремний.title: Silicon
Кремний.upper_limit: not established (not given in abstracts; the norm of 25 mg/day is mentioned in the review)
Кремний.who_needs: Indications are not defined: there is little data on the benefits of dietary supplements in humans; animal review reveals potential role in bone metabolism; For healthy people without deficiency, supplementation is not justified.

Куркумин.about: Turmeric polyphenol: inflammation (NF-κB); bioavailability itself is poor.
Куркумин.caution: The bioavailability of curcumin is VERY low without enhancers (piperine, liposomes, nanoparticles). Cochrane: Works to maintain remission in ulcerative colitis. For OA: moderate effect. For weight loss/cancer: data are weak. Caution: cholelithiasis, anticoagulants.
Куркумин.food_sources: Turmeric in food (about 3% curcumin); with piperine and fats the absorption is higher.
Куркумин.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved; a number of MAs have a modest effect in osteoarthritis (small trials, heterogeneity).
Куркумин.how_to_choose: Standardization of 95% curcuminoids + piperine or phosphosome/liquid forms; “turmeric powder in capsule” is weak.

interactions.note: enhances the effect, risk of bleeding

mechs: Inhibition of NF-κB, increase in BDNF; bioavailability is low (requires piperine)
Anti-inflammatory effect in GI: maintaining remission of ulcerative colitis
No relapses in combination with mesalazine
Metabolic effect in type 2 diabetes mellitus (body composition)
Body weight, BMI and waist circumference are lower (>1000 mg/day)
Куркумин.myths: “Turmeric in food = supplement dose” - 1-2 g of powder contains 30-60 mg of curcumin with poor absorption. “Completely cures inflammation”—the effect is modest.
Куркумин.name: Curcumin
Куркумин.onset: Joint pain - 4-8 weeks; there is no immediate effect.
Куркумин.title: Curcumin
Куркумин.upper_limit: There is no formal UL; high doses - GI discomfort; for gallstones - carefully (choleretic).
Куркумин.who_needs: Osteoarthritis as a supplement; components of metabolic syndrome (moderate data).

Лаванда.about: One of the few herbal anxiolytics tested in major RCTs (Silexan is a standardized oil). Compare with lorazepam in anxiety studies.
Лаванда.caution: Orally only standardized oil in capsules (Silexan). DO NOT take regular essential oil internally - it is toxic. During pregnancy - avoid. May enhance the effect of sedatives.
Лаванда.food_sources: As a spice in cooking (very little). The main one is essential oil or extract.
Лаванда.guidelines: There is RCT (Silexan vs lorazepam, vs placebo) - one of the few with a decent evidence base. EFSA health claims do not approve.
Лаванда.how_to_choose: Silexan (standardized preparation) or equivalent in capsules. For aromatherapy - 100% essential oil, not aromatic mixtures.
mechs: Linalyl acetate and linalool: modulation of GABA-A and NMDA receptors
Inhibition of calcium channels in neurons
Лаванда.myths: “All essential oils are the same” - no, only the standardized one with linalyl acetate works. “Instantly knocks you out” - a mild effect, not a sleeping pill.
Лаванда.name: Lavender
Лаванда.onset: 30-60 minutes for acute calming effect; 2-6 weeks for sustainable.
Лаванда.title: Lavender
Лаванда.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. Silexan capsules 80-160 mg/day are well tolerated.
Лаванда.who_needs: People with mild to moderate anxiety disorders. Students during stressful periods. As an evening ritual for sleep.

Лактоферрин.about: Milk glycoprotein: preterm lower late sepsis (2 Cochrane); children - sepsis and diarrhea, not ARI.
Лактоферрин.caution: Lactoferrin is a milk glycoprotein. For prematurity: 2 Cochrane reviews support prevention of late-onset sepsis and NEC. For pediatric infections: data available. For iron status: improves absorption. Safe. Caution: milk protein allergy.
Лактоферрин.food_sources: Lactoferrin - in breast milk (especially colostrum) and cow's milk; additive - extracted protein.
Лактоферрин.guidelines: Cochrane 2020 (12 RCT, 5425): late sepsis RR 0.82, NNTB 25, low quality. MA 2025: sepsis OR 0.60, diarrhea 0.56.
Лактоферрин.how_to_choose: 100-200 mg/day lactoferrin; for premature babies - only for their intended purpose; Be careful if you are allergic to milk.
mechs: Antimicrobial protection in premature infants (intestinal barrier)
Late sepsis: RR 0.82 (12 RCT, 5425, low confidence); NNTB 25
Pediatrics: sepsis OR 0.60, diarrhea OR 0.56; ARI without effect (25 studies)
Лактоферрин.myths: “Kills all infections” - from ARI in children without effect (OR 0.61, NS). “Works in adults” – neonatal/pediatric evidence.
Лактоферрин.name: Lactoferrin
Лактоферрин.onset: Preventive and course: in premature infants with regular addition to the diet.
Лактоферрин.title: Lactoferrin
Лактоферрин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Лактоферрин.who_needs: Premature under medical supervision (prevention of late sepsis, NNTB 25); children with frequent intestinal/septic infections.

Лизин.about: Lysine for herpes labialis: A 2015 Cochrane review (32 RCTs) found no evidence of prevention; safe, but no effect shown.
Лизин.caution: In the review, antiviral AEs were not increased; Lyzin - no recorded AEs, but no effect.
Лизин.food_sources: Meat, fish, eggs, legumes, cheese; the diet is not understood in abstracts; deficits in normal nutrition have not been described.
Лизин.guidelines: Cochrane 2015 (32 RCT, n=2640): Lysine was not found to be effective in preventing herpes; Long-term oral antivirals reduce relapses, but the benefit is small.
Лизин.how_to_choose: Do not choose Lysin for the prevention of herpes - there is no data; If there are frequent relapses, discuss antiviral medications with your doctor.
mechs: Lysin and prevention of recurrence of herpes on the lips
Long-term suppressive antiviral therapy as a basis for prevention
reduction in relapses, clinical benefit is small
Лизин.myths: “Lysine prevents herpes” - Cochrane 2015: no evidence. “Natural means it works” - relapses are reduced by antivirals, not Lysine. “More Lysin will heal faster” has not been studied.
Лизин.name: Lysine
Лизин.onset: No data: A 2015 review did not confirm the effectiveness of lysine for prevention.
Лизин.title: Lysine
Лизин.who_needs: People with recurrent herpes on the lips who are expecting prophylaxis from Lyzin - effectiveness has not been confirmed; in case of relapses, antiviral drugs are effective (clinical benefit is small).

Лютеин + зеаксантин.about: Macular carotenoids: antioxidant; slow down age-related macular degeneration, but do not save you from screens.
Лютеин + зеаксантин.caution: Lutein and zeaxanthin are retinal carotenoids. For age-related macular degeneration (AMD): systematic reviews show improvement in macular pigment and slower progression. For cataracts: risk reduction. For retinopathy of prematurity: Cochrane (40292760). AREDS2 formula (lutein + zeaxanthin) is the standard for AMD. Dose: 10 mg lutein + 2 mg zeaxanthin/day. Safe.
effects: AMD is slow; “blue light screens” - marketing (not confirmed)
Лютеин + зеаксантин.food_sources: Spinach, cabbage, egg yolk, corn, pumpkin are bioavailable with fats; taking them with oil is mandatory.
Лютеин + зеаксантин.guidelines: MA 2019: MPOD +0.07, pungency +0.28 (10–20 mg); nuclear cataract RR 0.63–0.73; AREDS2-dose 10+2 mg; premature - no.
Лютеин + зеаксантин.how_to_choose: AREDS2 dosage - 10 mg lutein + 2 mg zeaxanthin with fatty food; buy not “formulas”, but composition.
mechs: AMD is slow; “blue light screens” - marketing
Macular pigment density: linear with dose (10–20 mg/d)
Antioxidant in the lens: reduction of nuclear cataracts
Antioxidant Protection of Prematurity (ROP): The Claim
Retinal protection has not been confirmed in preterm infants (Cochrane 2025)
Лютеин + зеаксантин.myths: “They save you from blue screens” - protection from the monitor has not been proven. “Help prematurity” - ROP risk not reduced (Cochrane 2025).
Лютеин + зеаксантин.name: Lutein + Zeaxanthin
Лютеин + зеаксантин.onset: The density of macular pigment grows over months, faster by 20 mg; There is no effect in days.
Лютеин + зеаксантин.title: Lutein + Zeaxanthin
Лютеин + зеаксантин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Лютеин + зеаксантин.who_needs: People with age-related macular degeneration (AREDS2) and familial risk; for nuclear cataracts - observational data.

Магний.about: Cofactor of 300+ enzymes: muscles, nerves, sleep. The effect and tolerability depend on the form.
Магний.caution: Magnesium is an essential mineral. For arterial hypertension: Cochrane (16856052) confirms a decrease in pressure (especially if there is an initial deficiency). For type 2 diabetes: meta-analyses show improvement in HbA1c and insulin resistance. For seizures during pregnancy: data available. For migraine: there is data outside the database. Form matters: citrate/glycinate/malate is better than oxide. Dose: 200-400 mg/day. Caution: renal failure, bradycardia.
Магний.course: constantly when there is a shortage
Магний.food_sources: Pumpkin seeds, almonds, buckwheat, dark chocolate, leafy greens.
Магний.guidelines: EFSA: muscle and nervous system function; NIH: deficiency more common after age 70.
Магний.how_to_choose: Citrate, glycinate, bisglycinate - absorption and tolerability; oxide is cheap, poorly absorbed, weakens.

interactions.note: reduces absorption, separate doses for 2-4 hours

mechs: Mg2+ block NMDA + GABA modulation → decreased excitability
Regulation of vascular tone and blood pressure by magnesium ion
Decrease in systolic and diastolic pressure
Магний.myths: “Calms immediately” - the effect is cumulative. “Either form is the same” - the oxide barely raises levels.
Магний.name: Magnesium
Магний.onset: Sleep and cramps - 2-4 weeks; blood levels - 4-8 weeks.
Магний.title: Magnesium
Магний.who_needs: Refined nutrition, intense training, age 60+, deficiency according to analysis.

Майтаке.about: Maitake has been studied in animals: both meta-analyses of the polysaccharide were performed on mouse models; there is not a single RCT on humans in the pool.
Майтаке.caution: The authors of both meta-analyses noted the low quality of the included studies and the risk of bias in selection, detection, and reporting.
Майтаке.course: not specified in abstracts for humans
Майтаке.food_sources: Sources are not discussed in abstracts: both meta-analyses study isolated fungal polysaccharides, not food products.
Майтаке.guidelines: There are no recommendations for maitake in the pool: two sources are meta-analyses on animal models with SYRCLE risk of bias assessment.
Майтаке.how_to_choose: There is nothing to evaluate: there is no human dose data in the pool, so any extracts and combinations remain outside the scope of study.
mechs: Maitake polysaccharide suppressed tumor growth and increased remission rates in animal experiments
In animal models, an increase in CD4+ and CD8+ T lymphocytes, NK cells and macrophages was noted
Changes in immune parameters in animals
Transfer of data from animal models to humans in the pool is not justified
The effect in humans has not been studied
Майтаке.myths: “Meta-analysis proves benefit” - these are meta-analyses on animals; according to the rules of the project, they are not transferred to humans. “Immunity confirmed” - the authors themselves write that the quality of the work is low.
Майтаке.name: Maitake
Майтаке.onset: Not studied in humans: the timing of effect in both meta-analyses was based on animal models.
Майтаке.title: Maitake
Майтаке.who_needs: For no one, according to the pool: All 44 papers in the two meta-analyses were performed on animal models, not humans.

Мака.about: Maca root: sexual function and menopausal symptoms - limited evidence; does not affect hormones.
Мака.caution: Maca (Lepidium meyenii) is a root crop native to the Andes. For sexual function: improvement in men and women. For menopausal symptoms: data available. For male fertility: conflicting evidence. There is little data (2 MA). Dose: 1.5-3 g/day.
effects: Libido: small positive MA; hormones - no
Мака.food_sources: Maca root is a food raw material (powder, flour, food additive); doses 1.5-3 g/day.
Мака.guidelines: 2022 MA (sperm quality): higher volume/motility; 2024 MA (physical performance): weak signal. Libido - limited evidence.
Мака.how_to_choose: 1.5-3 g/day standardized root powder; The safety of long-term use has not been proven.
mechs: Libido: small positive MA; hormones - no
Biologically active components of the root: effect on libido
Sexual function plus in 2/4 RCT (including IIEF-5 in ED); limited evidence
Kupperman/Greene in plus (4/4 RCT); low quality, safety not proven
Мака.myths: “Aphrodisiac for everyone” - effect in 2 out of 4 RCTs. “Pumps up testosterone” - hormones do not change. “Menopause solved” - 4/4 RCT plus, quality low.
Мака.name: Maca
Мака.onset: Coursework: in RCT - weeks of intake 1.5-3 g / day; There is no one-time “lifting dose”.
Мака.title: Maca
Мака.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Мака.who_needs: Decreased libido, menopausal symptoms (data limited); healthy athletes - without obvious effect.

Марганец.about: Manganese is an essential trace element, but the SR on minerals for sports explicitly states: no relevant work on manganese was found.
Марганец.caution: ESPEN notes the potential toxicity of micronutrients in excess; There is no data on safe doses of manganese in the pool.
Марганец.food_sources: Cereals, nuts and tea; Separate data on the sources of manganese are not provided in the abstracts of the pool.
Марганец.guidelines: ESPEN 2022 makes recommendations for micronutrients based on consensus: there are few intervention studies, and a meta-analysis could not be performed.
Марганец.how_to_choose: Manganese supplementation is not supported by any human work in the pool; if a deficiency is suspected, analysis rather than independent use.
mechs: Minerals and trace elements are involved in hundreds of biological processes, and manganese belongs to this class
Correction of deficiency with nutritional support
Micronutrient deficiency is considered as a possible factor in the pathogenesis of androgenic alopecia
No relevant works on manganese were found in SR on sports minerals
The effect of the additive has not been studied
Марганец.myths: “All athletes need manganese” - no studies on manganese were found in SR for 128 works. “Improves hair growth” - in the SR on alopecia, manganese is only in the list, it is not in the conclusions.
Марганец.name: Manganese
Марганец.onset: Not studied: There is no RCT with manganese in the pool.
Марганец.title: Manganese
Марганец.who_needs: Only with confirmed deficiency or with nutritional support. Manganese deficiency was not identified in either the athletic performance data or the vegan diet data.

Медь.about: Copper is an essential mineral, but there is no data on the benefits of supplementation at normal levels: ESPEN explicitly notes the lack of intervention studies.
Медь.caution: ESPEN specifically addresses the potential toxicity of micronutrients in excess; There is no data on the upper limit specifically for copper in the pool.
Медь.course: not specified; ESPEN describes monitoring micronutrient status during nutritional support
Медь.food_sources: Liver, seafood, nuts, seeds and cocoa; The Vegan Diet SR lists copper as one of the nutrients for which no deficiency has been identified.
Медь.guidelines: ESPEN 2022: Recommendations for micronutrients are based on consensus, there are few intervention studies, a meta-analysis could not be carried out - the level of evidence is low.
Медь.how_to_choose: Pool copper supplements are not supported by any research; if a deficiency is suspected, use a blood test rather than taking it on your own.
mechs: Copper is an essential trace element necessary for metabolism; deficiency is detected in acute and chronic diseases
Deficiency or imbalance of micronutrients is considered as a possible factor in the pathogenesis of androgenetic alopecia
There is no direct data on the effect of copper intake on a healthy person in the studies studied.
The effect of the supplement outside of deficiency has not been confirmed
Медь.myths: “Everyone needs copper” - SR on a vegan diet did not reveal any copper deficiency. “Improves hair growth” - in the SR on androgenetic alopecia, copper is only in the list of micronutrients, the conclusions relate to B, D, Fe, Se, Zn.
Медь.name: Copper
Медь.onset: Not studied: There are no separate RCTs measuring the timing of the copper effect in the pool.
Медь.title: Copper
Медь.who_needs: Only with confirmed deficiency or with enteral and parenteral nutrition. In a normal diet, copper deficiency has not been identified, even among vegans.

Мелатонин.about: A circadian “biological night” signal hormone, not a sleeping pill.
Мелатонин.caution: Optimal dose for the elderly: 1-3 mg (not megadoses). Short half-life - better controlled forms. Does not cause addiction. Side effects: drowsiness, dizziness. Caution: autoimmune diseases, pregnancy.
Мелатонин.food_sources: Cherries, walnuts, rice - trace amounts, without practical role.
Мелатонин.guidelines: EFSA: 0.5 mg before bed reduces jet lag; NIH: short course for falling asleep.
Мелатонин.how_to_choose: Low doses 0.5-1 mg; without bundles “10 mg + herbs”.

interactions.note: Serotonin syndrome is rare but possible

mechs: Agonism of MT1/MT2 of the suprachiasmatic nucleus → circadian phase shift
Restoration of endogenous melatonin levels (reduced with aging and rhythm disturbances)
Sleep quality (PSQI) with impaired melatonin excretion
Pleiotropic effects of melatonin in clinical settings (surgery, IVF)
Later the need for analgesics, higher embryo quality
Мелатонин.myths: “More - you’ll fall asleep faster” - the dose-effect curve is flat after 1-3 mg. “It can take months” - there is little data, better in courses.
Мелатонин.name: Melatonin
Мелатонин.onset: Falling asleep - 30-60 minutes after taking; rhythm shift - 3-5 days of administration according to the scheme.
Мелатонин.title: Melatonin
Мелатонин.upper_limit: There is no formal UL; working doses 0.5-3 mg; 5-10 mg gives side effects, no effect.
Мелатонин.who_needs: Jet lag, shift schedule, late sleep type, age (its synthesis decreases).

Мелисса.about: A mild herbal anxiolytic from the mint family. One of the few with RCT on cognition under acute stress.
Мелисса.caution: Caution with hypothyroidism - there is evidence of an effect on the thyroid gland in large doses. May interact with sedatives and thyroid medications.
Мелисса.food_sources: Used as a spice and in teas. Fresh leaves - in salads and drinks.
Мелисса.guidelines: EMA is included in traditional herbal medicines as an anxiolytic and for GI. EFSA health claims do not approve.
Мелисса.how_to_choose: Standardized extract for rosmarinic acid 4-6%. Or a whole leaf for tea - no worse.
Мелисса.myths: “Replaces sleeping pills” - no, the effect is mild. “Helps everyone with anxiety” - works mainly for situational anxiety, not for clinical disorders.
Мелисса.name: Lemon Balm
Мелисса.onset: 30-60 minutes for acute effect; 2-4 weeks for sustained reduction in anxiety.
Мелисса.title: Lemon Balm
Мелисса.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. High doses (above 3 g/day of extract) can affect the thyroid gland.
Мелисса.who_needs: People in stressful periods - exams, deadlines. For mild anxiety. Like evening tea before bed.

Метионин.about: All three meta-analyses on methionine are about dairy cows, not people; for a person as a supplement there is no data in the pool.
Метионин.caution: Doses and effects cannot be transferred from dairy cows to humans: these animals use methionine to synthesize milk protein.
Метионин.course: not specified in abstracts for humans; in cows the optimal duration is 68-72 days
Метионин.food_sources: In the pool abstracts, food sources for humans are not discussed: all three meta-analyses are about feeding dairy cows.
Метионин.guidelines: There are no methionine recommendations for humans in the pool: only meta-analyses on dairy cow productivity are available.
Метионин.how_to_choose: There is nothing to choose: there are no confirmed doses for humans, and the grams indicated in the meta-analyses are calculated for reverse-transition cows.
mechs: In experiments on dairy cows, methionine supplementation increased milk protein yield by 2.23 g per 1 g of metabolized methionine
Increase in milk protein in cows
Crude milk yield did not respond significantly to methionine, only protein responded
Milk protein is growing, milk yield is not
There is no data on the effect of methionine intake on humans in the pool
The effect of the supplement in humans has not been studied
Метионин.myths: “Meta-analysis proves benefits” - all three were carried out on methionine for dairy cows, they cannot be transferred to humans. “Improves strength” - there is not a single work on humans in the pool.
Метионин.name: Methionine
Метионин.onset: Response times have only been studied in cows: 68-72 days for protected methionine. Not studied in humans.
Метионин.title: Methionine
Метионин.who_needs: For no one, according to the pool: all three meta-analyses were performed on cows, none on humans.

Молибден.about: Molybdenum is an essential trace element; There are no MAs prescribed for people in the selection: the reviews concern the status of microelements and toxic metals; dietary supplements have not been studied.
Молибден.caution: Excess micronutrients are potentially harmful; reviews note harm from excess metals - supplementation without indications is not justified.
Молибден.dosage: No data: the purpose of molybdenum in the abstracts has not been studied.
Молибден.food_sources: Legumes, grains, nuts, offal, dairy products; The content is highly dependent on the soil.
Молибден.guidelines: ESPEN 2022: trace elements are essential, deficiencies affect outcomes, monitoring is needed; reviews 2009 (hemodialysis) and 2026 - status in patients, purpose not studied.
Молибден.how_to_choose: Do not choose a supplement without indications - there is no data on effectiveness; if a deficiency is suspected, the status is assessed by a doctor.
mechs: Essential nature of microelements, the impact of deficiency on disease outcomes
maintenance of metabolism in case of deficiency (ESPEN 2022)
Tracking Micronutrient Levels in Dialysis Patients
in dialysis patients the level of a number of elements is changed; molybdenum among those tracked
Молибден.myths: “Microelements are equally beneficial for everyone” - the status of patients varies, there is no data. “A useful metal means an additive” - there is no evidence. “Toxic metals are only harmful” - some metals are essential, the question is the dose.
Молибден.name: Molybdenum
Молибден.onset: Not described: studies on the use of molybdenum were not found in abstracts.
Молибден.title: Molybdenum
Молибден.who_needs: No data on indications: groups are monitored as risk of deficiency or excess of microelements (chronic diseases, hemodialysis); With normal nutrition, the needs are covered.

Ниацинамид.about: Niacinamide (B3): reduces the risk of non-melanoma skin cancer in those with a history of it (RR 0.50, MA 2022); topically - for hyperpigmentation; the effect has not been described in healthy people.
Ниацинамид.caution: Increased risk of GI symptoms (MA 2022); topical forms are better tolerated; not to be confused with niacin.
Ниацинамид.course: Prevention is still relevant (according to RCT schemes from MA 2022); Topically - in courses.
Ниацинамид.food_sources: Meat, poultry, fish, liver, peanuts; nutritional status is not detailed in abstracts.
Ниацинамид.guidelines: MA 2022 (29 trials, n=3039): nicotinamide - skin cancer RR 0.50 [0.29-0.85], weak recommendation; reviews 2022/2025: topical niacinamide among treatments for PIH.
Ниацинамид.how_to_choose: Orally - only as prescribed by a doctor if you have a history of skin cancer; topical - niacinamide agents for pigmentation; not to be confused with niacin (flushing).
mechs: prevention of non-melanoma skin cancer (RR 0.50, MA 2022)
lightening of spots, high quality research
reduction of pigmentation along with lasers and other means
Ниацинамид.myths: “Lipid data - about niacin” - does not apply to nicotinamide. “Nicotinamide is harmless” - there are GI AEs (MA 2022). “Everyone needs it for their skin” - proven for groups at risk of skin cancer and hyperpigmentation.
Ниацинамид.name: Niacinamide
