Ниацинамид.onset: Chemoprophylaxis - in a course while taking it; in MA 2022, the effect on skin cancer and actinic keratoses is significant, GI AEs are noted.
Ниацинамид.title: Niacinamide
Ниацинамид.who_needs: Individuals with cancer or ≥1 skin cancer—chemoprophylaxis (weak GRADE recommendation); topically - for hyperpigmentation; There is no data for “everyone has energy”.

Омега-3.about: Polyunsaturated fatty acids: membranes, inflammation, brain, triglycerides.
Омега-3.caution: GENERAL omega-3s (DHA+EPA from fish oil) have LITTLE effect. Pure EPA (icosapent ethyl, prescription) - STRONG for hyperTG + CVD/diabetes. >4 g/day: risk of bleeding + AF. Cheap brands: contamination.
Омега-3.food_sources: Salmon, mackerel, sardines, herring; plant ALA (flax, walnut) is converted to EPA/DHA by 5-10%.
Омега-3.guidelines: EFSA: DHA for brain and vision. AHA: fish 2 times a week. Cochrane: at CVD events - “little or no effect” (not “modest”).
Омега-3.how_to_choose: On the can there are mg of EPA+DHA, not “fish oil 1000 mg”; TG/rTG forms; oxidation (TOTOX) if indicated.

interactions.note: enhances the effect, control of clotting

mechs: EPA/DHA in neuronal membranes + resolvins (resolution of inflammation)
High-dose EPA: stabilization of atherosclerotic plaques and triglycerides
Fewer cardiovascular events in high-risk and TG patients on statins
Омега-3.myths: “Any fish oil works” – a 1000 mg capsule can contain 300 mg EPA+DHA. “Plant omega equivalent” - ALA conversion is low.
Омега-3.name: Omega-3
Омега-3.onset: Triglycerides and CVD markers - 4-8 weeks; there is little data for other outcomes.
Омега-3.title: Omega-3
Омега-3.upper_limit: Up to 5 g EPA+DHA per day is safe (EFSA); above 3 g on anticoagulants - only with a doctor.
Омега-3.who_needs: Fatty fish less than 2 times a week; elevated triglycerides (with your doctor); pregnancy (DHA).

Орнитин.about: Ornithine was studied only for safety: SR 22 studies on healthy people found a maximum of 14,025 mg/day, but did not evaluate the effectiveness.
Орнитин.caution: The main adverse events in SR are gastrointestinal disorders; risk analysis showed a difference of 0.00 (95% CI ±0.02, p = 1.00).
Орнитин.course: the maximum duration studied in SR is 156 days; Dosage regimens for sports have not been studied
Орнитин.food_sources: In the abstracts of the pool, food sources are not discussed: SR only considered oral administration of the drug in addition to the usual diet.
Орнитин.guidelines: There are no clinical recommendations for ornithine in the pool: the only source is the SR for safety with a NOAEL calculation of 12,000 mg/day.
Орнитин.how_to_choose: The form studied was L-ornithine hydrochloride; It makes sense to take it only under the supervision of a doctor with a confirmed deficiency, and not for sports.
mechs: Ornithine is an essential amino acid with many physiological roles, but the mechanisms of the effect in the pool have not been understood
In SR 22 studies, analysis of adverse events did not reveal a significant difference in the risk of gastrointestinal disorders
GI disorders as the only observed risk
There is no data on the effect of ornithine intake on health indicators or performance in the pool
The effect of the additive has not been studied
Орнитин.myths: “Ornithine removes ammonia and relieves fatigue” - there is not a single work on effectiveness in the pool. “Safe means useful” - SR confirms only tolerability up to 12,000 mg/day.
Орнитин.name: Ornithine
Орнитин.onset: Not studied: the timing of the effect in SR for safety was not assessed, the maximum course studied was 156 days.
Орнитин.title: Ornithine
Орнитин.upper_limit: NOAEL 12,000 mg/day according to SR; there are no other boundaries in the pool
Орнитин.who_needs: For none according to the pool: The effectiveness of ornithine as a supplement has not been assessed in any review. The second source about taurine in newborns is a different substance.

Пажитник.about: Trigonella spice: in diabetics reduces fasting, after meals and HbA1c sugar; healthy people do not.
Пажитник.caution: Fenugreek (Trigonella foenum-graecum). For glycemic control: meta-analysis (24438170) shows reduction in fasting sugar. For lactation: Individual RCTs show an increase in milk volume. For testosterone/libido: data are limited and conflicting. There is little data (1 abstract in the database). Safe in standard doses (5-15 g seeds or 500-1000 mg extract).
effects: Glycemia is moderate; libido is weak
Пажитник.food_sources: Fenugreek seeds are a spice and the basis of culinary mixtures; for working doses you need a powder/extract.
Пажитник.guidelines: 2023 MA (glycemia): FBG −0.96, HbA1c −0.85% in T2D; 2023 MA (metabolic syndrome): components improved. Healthy people - no effect.
Пажитник.how_to_choose: Extract standardized for saponins, 500 mg - several g/day; for T2D - glycemic control with a doctor.
mechs: Glycemia is moderate; libido is weak
Saponins and soluble fiber: glucose utilization
MA (10 RCT): FBG −0.96, postprandial −2.19 mmol/l, HbA1c −0.85%; effect at medium/high doses and in diabetics
Пажитник.myths: “Burns fat and pumps up testosterone” - the data is contradictory. “Reduces sugar for everyone” - the effect of MA is only in diabetics at medium/high doses.
Пажитник.name: Fenugreek
Пажитник.onset: Coursework: in RCT from 1 week of admission; affects sugar on an empty stomach and after meals, not acutely.
Пажитник.title: Fenugreek
Пажитник.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Пажитник.who_needs: T2D with the need for mild glycemic control (adjunct); nursing - separate RCT; there is little data on libido/testosterone.

Пассифлора.about: Mild herbal sedative. One of the few to show an effect in RCT on falling asleep - comparable to oxazepam in some studies (but small samples).
Пассифлора.caution: Caution for hypotension (may reduce blood pressure). Rarely - sedative interaction with alcohol and barbiturates. Cancel 2 weeks before surgery.
Пассифлора.food_sources: Not consumed as food - leaves and flowers in the form of infusion or extract.
Пассифлора.guidelines: It is included in the European phytotherapeutic tradition as an anxiolytic. EFSA does not approve health claims, but the EMA does include traditional herbal medicines.
Пассифлора.how_to_choose: Standardized extract for flavonoids (vitexin 2-4%). Tea mixtures are weaker, but work for mild anxiety.
mechs: Maltol and ethyl maltol: reducing anxiety
Пассифлора.myths: “Replaces sleeping pills” - no, the effect is weaker and milder. “Instantly knocks you out” - does not work like benzodiazepines.
Пассифлора.name: Passionflower
Пассифлора.onset: 30-60 minutes after administration; for a lasting effect - 1-2 weeks.
Пассифлора.title: Passionflower
Пассифлора.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. Doses up to 4 g of dry leaf are well tolerated.
Пассифлора.who_needs: People with difficulty falling asleep (stressful periods). Not for chronic insomnia - there's melatonin or CBT-I. For mild anxiety.

Пикногенол.about: Pine bark extract: moderately reduces blood pressure, lipids and glucose; “panacea” has not been proven.
Пикногенол.caution: Pycnogenol is an extract of the bark of the French maritime pine (Pinus pinaster). There is 1 Cochrane review (22513958) on chronic diseases. For blood pressure: moderate decrease. For lipids: data are mixed. Safe in standard doses (50-200 mg/day). Antioxidant properties have been well studied, but clinical outcomes are often limited.
Пикногенол.food_sources: Not a food product: maritime pine bark extract is sold as a dietary supplement; There are no working doses in food.
Пикногенол.guidelines: 2025 MA (cardiometabolic profile): SBP/LDL lower; 2023 MA (ED): effective when combined with arginine. Widespread prevention has not been confirmed.
Пикногенол.how_to_choose: 50-100 mg of standardized extract (70% procyanidins), course >12 weeks.
mechs: Veins/swelling is moderate; cognition is weak; the price is inadequate
SBP −3.2, DBP −1.9 mmHg; DBP only on course >12 weeks
Cardiometabolic profile: glucose, lipids, blood pressure
Glucose −5.9, LDL −7.1, HDL +3.3 mg/dL; HbA1c −0.29% (24 RCT, 1594 people)
Claimed broad prevention of chronic diseases
Cochrane 2012: results for 7 nosologies are not generalizable (15 RCT, 791 people)
Пикногенол.myths: “Cures 7 diseases” - it was not possible to generalize (heterogeneity, different outcomes). “Worth the money” - the working niches are narrow.
Пикногенол.name: Pycnogenol
Пикногенол.onset: Course and moderate: DBP responds only to >12 weeks; glucose and lipids - in weeks.
Пикногенол.title: Pycnogenol
Пикногенол.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Пикногенол.who_needs: Cardiometabolic problems (BP, lipids, glucose) as an addition to treatment; There is an effect in combination with therapy, but a weaker effect - separately.

Пробиотики.about: Living cultures; the effect is STRAIN SPECIFIC - “a probiotic at all” does not exist.
Пробиотики.caution: The effect is STRAIN-SPECIFIC. Proven strains: Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG, Saccharomyces boulardii, Bifidobacterium infantis 35624. Contraindicated in: premature infants (FDA warning 2023), patients with CVC, immunocompromised, acute pancreatitis - risk of bacteremia.
Пробиотики.food_sources: Yogurt, kefir, sauerkraut, kimchi, kombucha are related, but not equal to the additive.
Пробиотики.guidelines: Cochrane: Moderate evidence for L. rhamnosus GG and S. boulardii in antibiotic diarrhea; EFSA: immunity claims not approved.
Пробиотики.how_to_choose: Strain on label (LGG, not just Lactobacillus); CFU for expiration date, not for release; storage conditions.

interactions.note: separate intake 2 hours, probiotic after the course

mechs: Strain-specific: L. rhamnosus GG - intestinal barrier; S. boulardii - diarrhea on antibiotics
Restoration of microbiota + barrier function during a course of antibiotics
Antibiotic-associated diarrhea in children: less common (33 RCT, 6352)
Competition with C. difficile for a niche and mucosal immunomodulation
CDAD after antibiotics: prevention in adults/children (2025)
Reducing the duration of acute infectious diarrhea (probiotics)
Diarrhea is shorter; the effect is stable in sensitivity (82 RCT, 12 127)
Пробиотики.myths: “More billions of CFU is better” – the strain and the evidence are more important. “Populates the intestines forever” - transient in nature.
Пробиотики.name: Probiotics
Пробиотики.onset: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea - from 1-2 days of co-administration; IBS - 4-8 weeks.
Пробиотики.title: Probiotics
Пробиотики.upper_limit: No UL; caution with immunosuppression and central venous catheters.
Пробиотики.who_needs: Diarrhea on antibiotics (specific strains), IBS (strain-dependent), recovery after a course of antibiotics.

Пролин.about: Free proline as a supplement has not been studied: all studies in the pool are about collagen and gelatin, where proline is only a compound amino acid.
Пролин.caution: The pool data refer to collagen and not to free proline: tolerability and dosage of the amino acid itself were not assessed.
Пролин.course: in collagen studies - from 3 days to 1 week; schemes have not been studied for proline
Пролин.dosage: Free proline doses have not been studied; in RCT, 15 g of collagen peptides were used twice a day and 15-30 g of hydrolyzate
Пролин.food_sources: In the pool abstracts, food sources are not discussed: only oral administration of collagen and gelatin peptides was studied.
Пролин.guidelines: There are no recommendations for free proline in the pool: studies are available on collagen and gelatin, not the amino acid itself.
Пролин.how_to_choose: There is nothing to choose: there is no confirmed dose of free proline, and the data on collagen refer to another product.
mechs: In the RCT of collagen peptides in the blood, glycine, proline and hydroxyproline increased, but connective tissue synthesis did not increase
Collagen hydrolyzate at a dose of 15-30 g dose-dependently increased the PINP marker in 8 men with training experience
Proline alone was not used in pool studies
The effect of free proline has not been studied
Пролин.myths: “Collagen works, so does proline” - in RCT with collagen peptides, proline in the blood increased, but the synthesis of connective tissue did not increase. “Restores tendons” - there are no direct RCTs for proline in the pool.
Пролин.name: Proline
Пролин.onset: The timing of response to free proline has not been studied; in collagen studies, patterns were limited to days.
Пролин.title: Proline
Пролин.who_needs: For none in the pool: None of the studies provided proline as a stand-alone supplement.

Псиллиум.about: Soluble fiber: cholesterol, sugar, stool regularity.
Псиллиум.caution: ONE of the most proven fibers. The effect is dose-dependent: optimal ≥10 g/day 15 minutes before meals. Safe for a long time. GI side effects (bloating) in the first weeks. Adequate water intake is required.
effects: LDL and stool: stable effect (not confirmed)
Псиллиум.food_sources: Flea plantain seeds; additives = husk (98% fiber).
Псиллиум.guidelines: EFSA: 10 g/day lowers cholesterol; FDA: health claim for the heart.
Псиллиум.how_to_choose: Husk (husk), not whole seeds; powder or capsules.

interactions.note: reduces absorption, separate doses for 2 hours

mechs: Viscous gel: slows absorption of glucose and lipids
T2D/prediabetes: glucose, HbA1c, HOMA-IR lower (GRADE-meta, 19 RCT, 962 people)
Weight −2.1 kg, waist −2.2 cm at 10.8 g/day before meals (6 RCT, 354)
Псиллиум.myths: “Replaces vegetables” - there is fiber, but no vitamins. “Works without water” - constipation without water.
Псиллиум.name: Psyllium
Псиллиум.title: Psyllium
Псиллиум.upper_limit: 30 g/day; higher - bloating; drink a lot of water.
Псиллиум.who_needs: High cholesterol, constipation, prediabetes, weight control.

Пустырник.about: Motherwort: traditionally "nervous heart"; sedative/hypotensive effect in an open clinic, no MA.
Пустырник.caution: Motherwort (Leonurus cardiaca). There are NO meta-analyses or systematic reviews in the database. A popular remedy in Eastern European traditional medicine for 'calming the heart', anxiety, palpitations. But there is no evidence base. Not recommended for serious cardiovascular diseases without medical supervision. May interact with anticoagulants.
Пустырник.food_sources: Motherwort herb is not food, a raw material for tea/tincture/extract; Pharmacopoeia standardizes flavonoids ≥0.2%.
Пустырник.guidelines: RCT 2011 (n=50, 28 days): CGI 80% with improvement but no placebo. Reviews 2013/2021: phytochemistry, no clinical MA.
Пустырник.how_to_choose: Extract/tincture according to pharmacopoeia (flavonoids ≥0.2%); for hypertension - monitor blood pressure with a doctor.
mechs: Stage 1 hypertension + anxiety: CGI improvement ~80% (28 days, n=50)
Isolated hearts/mitochondria: uncoupled oxidation, less ROS; laboratory cardioprotection
Пустырник.myths: “From heartbeats to everyone” - electrophysiology only in isolated hearts. “Safe” - interactions with anticoagulants and antihypertensives.
Пустырник.name: Motherwort
Пустырник.onset: Coursework: in grade 1 hypertension the effect is a week earlier than in grade 2; course 28 days (n=50).
Пустырник.title: Motherwort
Пустырник.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Пустырник.who_needs: Mild hypertension stage 1 with anxiety/insomnia (adjunct, open data); for serious CVD - only with a doctor.

Расторопша.about: Silymarin stabilizes hepatocyte membranes; improves markers, clinical significance is controversial.
Расторопша.caution: Milk thistle (Silybum marianum, silymarin). For metabolic liver dysfunction (MLD): there is a Cochrane review. For alcoholic/viral hepatitis: Cochrane shows limited effectiveness. For insulin resistance: there is data. Clinical significance is controversial—biochemical markers improve, but clinical outcomes are often insignificant. Safe.
Расторопша.food_sources: Ordinary seeds are only suitable for tea; clinical dose - standardized silymarin 420 mg.
Расторопша.guidelines: Cochrane 2007 (18 RCT, 1088): overall mortality NS, hepatic RR 0.50; SR 2025: HOMA-IR −2.29 in T2D, not in NAFLD.
Расторопша.how_to_choose: Silymarin 420 mg/day (not powder), courses for months; in case of complaints, first diagnose the liver.
mechs: Reducing insulin resistance in patients with T2D
HOMA-IR −2.29 (p=0.047); FI no effect; improved in T2D, not in NAFLD (n=673)
Hepatic mortality RR 0.50, but overall NS; RCT quality low (2007)
Расторопша.myths: “Restores the liver after alcohol” - does not reduce overall mortality (RR 0.78). “Sugar for everyone” - HOMA-IR falls only in T2D, not in NAFLD.
Расторопша.name: Milk Thistle
Расторопша.onset: Course effect: enzymes and HOMA-IR after 4–12 weeks; There is no quick “liver cleanse”.
Расторопша.title: Milk Thistle
Расторопша.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Расторопша.who_needs: ASLD/NAFLD (adjunct to lifestyle); for insulin resistance in T2D - there is data.

Рейши.about: Ganoderma: adjuvant to oncology therapy - QoL and immunity are slightly better; "dream" is not confirmed.
Рейши.caution: Reishi (Ganoderma lucidum) is the 'mushroom of immortality' from traditional Chinese medicine. For cancer: 2 Cochrane reviews (27045603, 22696372) show possible benefit as an ADJUVANT to chemotherapy (improved immune response, quality of life), but NOT as monotherapy. For general immune function: limited data. For sleep/anxiety: no systematic data. Safe in standard doses.
Рейши.food_sources: As a rare product (bitter, hard); clinical form - extract 1-2 g/day.
Рейши.guidelines: 2023 SR (mushrooms in onco): adjuvant - leukocytes and QoL higher; 2026 SR (diabetes): glycemia lower. Monotherapy is not recommended.
Рейши.how_to_choose: 1-2 g of extract/day, standardization for polysaccharides and triterpenes; in case of oncology - only with a doctor.
mechs: Beta-glucans (G. lucidum) as an adjuvant for cancer therapy
Cochrane 2016 (5 RCT): WBC and quality of life moderately better; monotherapy is not recommended
Рейши.myths: “Mushroom of immortality against cancer” - 5 RCT, adjuvant only; monotherapy is not recommended. “Deep sleep” - no data on sleep/anxiety.
Рейши.name: Reishi
Рейши.onset: Coursework and modest (weeks); Acute “immune elevation”/drowsiness is not indicated in RCT.
Рейши.title: Reishi
Рейши.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Рейши.who_needs: Patients with cancer as an adjuvant (discuss with doctor); without the diagnosis “boost immunity/sleep” - there is no evidence.

Ресвератрол.about: Grape polyphenol: improves biomarkers (lipids, glucose), clinical value not proven.
Ресвератрол.caution: Resveratrol is a polyphenol from grapes. There is a lot of data on biomarkers (lipids, inflammation, oxidative stress, insulin resistance), but clinical outcomes are often insignificant. Bioavailability is low (rapidly metabolized). Doses in RCT are often very high (500-1500 mg/day), in dietary supplements - 50-100 mg. For obesity/type 2 diabetes: data available. For cardiovascular outcomes: effect not proven. 'French paradox' - marketing.
Ресвератрол.food_sources: Grapes, red wine, peanuts, blueberries; dietary doses cannot reach the RCT level (500+ mg).
Ресвератрол.guidelines: Umbrella 2026 (45 MA): waist −0.8 cm, cholesterol and blood pressure in T2D - high confidence; glucose and endothelium - average.
Ресвератрол.how_to_choose: T2D/overweight only: 100–500 mg from RCT; regular dietary supplements of 50–100 mg are meaningless.
mechs: Activation of SIRT1 (sirtuins) - proven in mice
Bioavailability in humans ~0, effect not confirmed
Metabolic action (SIRT1/AMPK): insulin and glucose sensitivity
Fasting glucose, HbA1c and insulin resistance are lower in T2D
Vascular endothelial support: flow-dependent vasodilation, adhesion molecules
Vascular function is higher (FMD +1.43%), BP is lower in T2D
Ресвератрол.myths: “Like a glass of wine” - French paradox marketing, the doses in wine are cheap. “Anti-aging” - bioavailability in humans is ~0, dietary supplement 50 mg is far from RCT doses.
Ресвератрол.name: Resveratrol
Ресвератрол.onset: Metabolic effects course: weeks-months; there is no immediate effect.
Ресвератрол.title: Resveratrol
Ресвератрол.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Ресвератрол.who_needs: T2D (BP, cholesterol, insulin resistance) and obesity (waist); healthy - no effect.

Рибофлавин.about: Vitamin B2 is a mitochondrial cofactor; works as a prophylaxis for migraine in adults (400 mg/day).
Рибофлавин.caution: Riboflavin (vitamin B2). For migraine prevention: systematic reviews (33779525, 28485121) show effectiveness at a dose of 400 mg/day. The effect develops after 2-3 months. Safe, no serious side effects (bright yellow urine is normal). For hereditary metabolic diseases (complex I deficiency): data available. For anemia there is no systematic data.
Рибофлавин.food_sources: Milk, eggs, mushrooms, liver, almonds, greens; Deficiency is rare, for migraines - doses of supplements, not food.
Рибофлавин.guidelines: MA 2022 (9 articles, 673 people): days/frequency/duration/pain lower. SR 2017: stable in adults, combinations do not help.
Рибофлавин.how_to_choose: Regular riboflavin 400 mg/day (not “active forms”), course from 3 months; cheap and safe.
mechs: Correction of mitochondrial dysfunction in migraine
Migraine: fewer days, frequency, duration and pain at 400 mg/day (8 RCT, 673)
Prophylactic profile: adults vs children and combinations
In adults, the effect is stable; mixed in children; combinations don't help
Рибофлавин.myths: “Relieves an attack immediately” - prevention: less often after 2-3 months. “Yellow urine is dangerous” is the norm; in children the effect is mixed.
Рибофлавин.name: Riboflavin
Рибофлавин.onset: The effect develops after 2–3 months of taking 400 mg/day; Migraine does not stop quickly.
Рибофлавин.title: Riboflavin
Рибофлавин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Рибофлавин.who_needs: Adults with frequent migraines who need non-drug prevention; In children the effect is mixed; healthy people do not need it.

Родиола.about: Adaptogen: reduces fatigue, improves concentration during stress.
Родиола.caution: Rhodiola rosea is an adaptogen. Systematic reviews show modest effects on fatigue, but the quality of RCTs is often low. For athletic performance: data are conflicting. For depression: insufficient data. Safety: good in short-term RCTs. Optimal dose: 200-600 mg/day standardized extract (3-6% rosavins).
Родиола.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved; MA—moderate effect on fatigue.
mechs: Adaptogen: HPA axis modulation, mild MAO inhibition
Reducing mental fatigue during stress (adaptogenic response)
Mental fatigue: 3/5 RCT positive, risk of displacement high (SR 2012)
Acute: Stamina and RPE plus; chronic: anaerobic, non-aerobic (13 RCT)
Родиола.myths: “Replaces coffee” is a different mechanism, not a stimulant. “Works for everyone” - the effect depends on baseline fatigue.
Родиола.name: Rhodiola
Родиола.onset: Mental fatigue - accumulates over 1-2 weeks; Acute effects in reviews are inconsistent.
Родиола.title: Rhodiola
Родиола.who_needs: Burnout, mental fatigue, shift schedule, students in session.

Селен.about: Selenium is a trace element for the thyroid gland; the effect of dietary supplements was confirmed in patients with Hashimoto's thyroiditis; in healthy people with normal status, no benefit was shown.
Селен.caution: Toxic in excess (selenosis); if the status is normal, supplements are not recommended; discuss the dose with your doctor.
Селен.course: Course according to RCT schemes from MA 2024 (weeks-months), duration - on the dynamics of antibodies and TSH under the supervision of a physician.
Селен.dosage: The exact dose of selenium in dietary supplements is not given in the abstracts.
Селен.food_sources: Brazil nuts, seafood, eggs, meat, organ meats, whole grains; The content in food depends greatly on the soil.
Селен.guidelines: MA 2024 (35 RCT): selenium reduces TSH (SMD -0.21), TPOAb (SMD -0.96), MDA; network-MA 2024: TPOAb (SMD -2.44) and TgAb (SMD -2.76); ESPEN 2022: status monitoring.
Селен.how_to_choose: Only in cases of confirmed deficiency or Hashimoto's disease, the dose is as per the doctor; if the status is normal, the supplement is not indicated.
mechs: Participation in the synthesis of selenoproteins and antioxidant protection of the thyroid gland
reduction of TPOAb/TgAb and TSH in Hashimoto's (MA 2024)
reduction in MDA when taking selenium (MA 2024)
Effective only in case of deficiency or autoimmune process
healthy people with normal levels have no effect
Селен.myths: “Selenium is good for everyone’s thyroid gland” - the effect is shown for Hashimoto’s, but not for everyone. “It’s worth drinking just in case” - no benefit is shown at normal levels. “Every form is the same”—the forms in the abstracts were not compared.
Селен.name: Selenium
Селен.onset: In Hashimoto's, a decrease in TPOAb and TSH is described by the course of administration; in MA 2024, the effect on TSH (SMD -0.21) is within the framework of RCT, the timing is not allocated.
Селен.title: Selenium
Селен.upper_limit: not established (not given in abstracts; high doses - risk of selenosis)
Селен.who_needs: Patients with Hashimoto's thyroiditis - decreased antibodies and TSH (MA 2024); if selenium deficiency is confirmed, correction according to status; For healthy people with normal levels, the supplement is not indicated.

Серин.about: Serine was studied only in rare genetic diseases - HSAN1 and GRIN2B variants: 18 patients and 4 children. For everyone else, it has not been tested as a supplement.
Серин.caution: The dose in studies is hundreds of milligrams per kilogram of weight; inclusion in the study was determined by genetic diagnosis and not by supplementation requirement.
Серин.course: 12 months in RCT for HSAN1; two 6-month cycles in the GRIN2B studies
Серин.food_sources: The pool abstracts do not discuss dietary sources: both studies used oral L-serine as the drug.
Серин.guidelines: There are no recommendations for serine in the pool: there are two point studies in rare genetic diseases, without meta-analyses.
Серин.how_to_choose: The form studied was oral L-serine; Self-administration is pointless: doses are designed for specific genetic diagnoses.
mechs: L-serine serves as a precursor to D-serine, which modulates the activity of NMDA receptors
In RCT for HSAN1, the improvement in the CMTNS scale was 1.5 points (95% CI -2.8…-0.1, p = 0.03)
Of the 14 additional PRPP-A measures, there were no significant differences; secondary outcomes varied
No significant effect on secondary outcomes
Серин.myths: “Works like a nootropic” - in RCT the effect was 1.5 points on the scale in 18 patients with a rare disease. “Safe for everyone” - a dose of hundreds of mg per kg of body weight, self-administration is inappropriate.
Серин.name: Serine
Серин.onset: In RCT for HSAN1 - an annual course with an improvement of 1.5 points on the CMTNS scale; in GRIN2B studies - 6 months per cycle.
Серин.title: Serine
Серин.upper_limit: not listed in abstracts; in RCT 400 mg/kg/day was used
Серин.who_needs: Only patients with confirmed pathology - HSAN1 or GRIN2B variants - and under medical supervision. There is no general recommendation for healthy people.

Сульфорафан.about: Active substance from broccoli and other cruciferous vegetables. Potent antioxidant in vitro, but RCTs in humans are few and small. The actual effect of food may be greater than that of capsules.
Сульфорафан.caution: For hypothyroidism - be careful (in high doses it affects the thyroid gland). Rarely - GI discomfort. Human studies are limited, with most of the data being in vitro.
Сульфорафан.food_sources: Broccoli (especially sprouts - up to 100x more sulforaphane than mature ones), Brussels sprouts, cauliflower, kale.
Сульфорафан.guidelines: EFSA does not approve. It is being actively studied in cancer prevention, but so far there are no definitive recommendations.
Сульфорафан.how_to_choose: Extract from broccoli sprouts with glucoraphanin + myrosinase (important - active sulforaphane is formed only upon their contact).

interactions.note: high doses can affect the thyroid gland - TSH control

mechs: Activation of the Nrf2 pathway: induction of antioxidant enzymes
Phase II detox enzymes, xenobiotic protection
Inhibition of NF-κB: reduction of inflammatory cytokines
Сульфорафан.myths: “Cures cancer” is an exaggeration, in vitro ≠ in vivo. “Replaces broccoli” - no, the effect of food may be stronger and safer.
Сульфорафан.name: Sulforaphane
Сульфорафан.onset: 4-8 weeks for changes in biomarkers (CRP, glutathione). There are no acute effects.
Сульфорафан.title: Sulforaphane
Сульфорафан.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. High doses (60+ mg/day) can affect the thyroid gland.
Сульфорафан.who_needs: People concerned with prevention (mainly long-term goals). If you eat cruciferous vegetables regularly, you don’t need a supplement—the effect comes from eating.

Сывороточный протеин.about: Gold Standard Protein: Leucine + Full Amino Profile; works with strength loads and sarcopenia.
Сывороточный протеин.caution: Whey protein is the gold standard of protein for athletes and seniors. For muscle mass: Multiple meta-analyses support effectiveness when combined with strength training. For sarcopenia in the elderly: works. For glycemic control: improvement of postprandial glucose. For weight loss: there is evidence when combined with diet. Isolate vs. concentrate: isolate contains more protein. Dose: 20-40 g/day.
effects: Muscles and sarcopenia prevention: extensive MA
Сывороточный протеин.food_sources: Whey: milk, kefir, cottage cheese; Using supplements, they eat up protein sparingly when food is scarce.
Сывороточный протеин.guidelines: MA 2023–2024: with sarcopenia, muscle SMD 0.47 and walking 1.13; body composition - only with exercise and a calorie deficit.
Сывороточный протеин.how_to_choose: Isolate for lactose intolerance; 20–40 g after training; the benchmark is leucine ≥2.5 g per serving.
mechs: Leucine → mTOR + full amino profile → muscle synthesis
Muscles and sarcopenia prevention: extensive MA
Support muscle mass and function in sarcopenia
For sarcopenia: muscle mass (SMD 0.47), walking speed (1.13), grip strength higher (with RT)
Body composition: lean mass up, fat and waist down
Best effect for overweight: with strength training and calorie deficit (35 RCT)
Decrease in pro-inflammatory signal (IL-6), increase in IGF-1
In sarcopenia: IL-6 is lower, IGF-1 and albumin are higher
Сывороточный протеин.myths: “It builds muscle on its own” – without strength training there is no effect on sarcopenia (10 RCT, 1154). “The more, the better” - above 2.2 g/kg there is no benefit.
Сывороточный протеин.name: Whey Protein
Сывороточный протеин.onset: The effect accumulates through training and is visible in 8–16 weeks; The mass does not provide a quick pump.
Сывороточный протеин.title: Whey Protein
Сывороточный протеин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Сывороточный протеин.who_needs: Athletes (1.6–2.2 g protein/kg/day), elderly with sarcopenia, losing weight with a calorie deficit.

Таурин.about: Sulfoamino acid-osmolyte: improves cardiometabolic markers - glucose, lipids, blood pressure, liver.
Таурин.caution: Taurine is a sulfonic acid with many functions. For cardiometabolism: Meta-analyses show modest improvements in blood pressure/lipids in people with metabolic problems. For cognitive function: limited data (40320621). For height in low birth weight infants: data available (29368111). Safe in doses of 1-6 g/day.
Таурин.food_sources: Meat, seafood, fish are the main sources; vegetarians are in a low consumption area, but shortages are rare.
Таурин.guidelines: MA 2026 (34 RCT): glucose −5.9 mg/dL, TG −14.4, LDL −5.1, SBP −4.4, AST/ALT down; dose-effect 1.5–3 g/day.
Таурин.how_to_choose: Taurine 1.5–3 g/day for T2D/hypertension/steatosis; for “energy” or mind - do not take it.
mechs: Glucose −5.9, LDL −5.1, TG −14.4 mg/dL; HOMA-IR −0.57 (34 RCT)
AST −9.7, ALT −8.3 U/l; MDA (SMD −1.16) and CRP lower
Cognition: no effect (7 RCT, 402 people); MMSE +3.09 only in conjunction with medications
Таурин.myths: “Calms and helps to think” - cognition without effect (7 RCT, 402); “energy” - the dose in a jar (~mg) is a penny versus workers 1.5–3 g.
Таурин.name: Taurine
Таурин.onset: Cardiometabolic effect of the course: weeks-months; There is no “calm down” in RCT.
Таурин.title: Taurine
Таурин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Таурин.who_needs: Metabolic syndrome, T2D, steatosis, hypertension - cardiometabolic markers; for the "mind" without evidence.

Тирозин.about: Dopamine precursor: maintains working memory during acute stress/lack of sleep; does not affect sports.
Тирозин.caution: ONLY 1 relevant meta-analysis after screening (the rest are about tyrosine kinase inhibitors in oncology, not about amino acids). For cognitive function under stress: single RCT evidence, low quality. For sports results: no systematic proofs.
Тирозин.food_sources: Cheese, chicken, fish, turkey, peanuts, bananas; for acute stress, L-tyrosine 500–2000 mg is easier.
Тирозин.guidelines: SR 2015 (15 papers): cognitive buffer only under stress; sports results do not improve; single dose data.
Тирозин.how_to_choose: L-tyrosine 500–2000 mg once under stress (competition, night without sleep); not for regular use.
mechs: Cognition ONLY during acute stress/lack of sleep
Replenishment of depleted catecholamines in the brain during exercise (dopamine, norepinephrine)
Working memory and information processing are affected by stress and overload
Claimed ergogenicity in sports via catecholamines (muscle fatigue)
No effect on athletic performance in most studies
Тирозин.myths: “Accelerates the brain for everyone” - only against the background of depleted catecholamines. “Sports doping” - performance does not increase.
Тирозин.name: Tyrosine
Тирозин.onset: Acute single action (500–2000 mg before exercise); courses have not been studied.
Тирозин.title: Tyrosine
Тирозин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Тирозин.who_needs: Only under acute cognitive stress: lack of sleep, extreme conditions, high cognitive stress; There is no “for tone” for healthy people.

Трибулус.about: The myth of the “testosterone booster”: it does not affect T in most people; for erectile dysfunction, IIEF is higher.
Трибулус.caution: Tribulus (Tribulus terrestris). There are NO meta-analyses or systematic reviews in PubMed. Individual RCTs show no significant effect on testosterone in healthy men. Popularity as a 'testosterone booster' in sports nutrition has NOT been proven. For libido in women: limited data. Safe in standard doses, but effectiveness is questionable.
Трибулус.food_sources: Tribulus fruits and grass are not food; clinical form - standardized saponin extract.
Трибулус.guidelines: MA 2026 (8 RCT): IIEF-5 +3.23 vs placebo, testosterone NS. SR 2025 (10): T does not change. SR 2014: marketing unfounded.
Трибулус.how_to_choose: Saponin extract 750-1500 mg/day; for ED - see a doctor; “testosterone boosters” are not worth paying for.
mechs: Saponins and NO signaling: erectile function
MA 2026 (8 studies): IIEF-5 +3.23 and IIEF-15 +14.44 versus placebo; testosterone did not change
SR 2025 (10 studies): testosterone does not increase in the majority; +60–70 ng/dl only in hypogonals (small value)
Трибулус.myths: “Pumps up testosterone” - for the majority there are no changes, an increase only in hypogonal ones (+60-70 ng/dl). Strength and Mass - SR 2022 unchanged.
Трибулус.name: Tribulus
Трибулус.onset: Course course: 1-3 months at 400-750 mg/day; there is no acute effect, T does not increase in healthy people.
Трибулус.title: Tribulus
Трибулус.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Трибулус.who_needs: Erectile dysfunction (IIEF better, T unchanged); female sex function - low evidence; for sports “testosterone” - no.

Триптофан.about: Serotonin/melatonin precursor: with ≥1 g/day, fewer night awakenings; the mood is mildly better.
Триптофан.caution: L-tryptophan is a precursor of serotonin. Effect on sleep ONLY at >=1 g/day. DO NOT combine with SSRI/MAOI (serotonin syndrome). Dose: 0.14-3 g/day.
Триптофан.food_sources: Turkey, milk, cheese, eggs, bananas, oatmeal; for 1 g/day it is more convenient to supplement with L-tryptophan.
Триптофан.guidelines: MA 2022: awakenings −81 min/g (SMD −1.08), stronger with ≥1 g/day. SR 2021 (11 RCT): Low Alert.
Триптофан.how_to_choose: L-tryptophan ≥1 g/day before bedtime course; do not combine with SSRI/MAOI due to serotonin syndrome.
mechs: Melatonin synthesis: dosage ≥1 g reduces awakenings
WASO −81 min/g (SMD −1.08); other sleep components unchanged
Boosting Serotonin: Reducing Anxiety in Healthy People
Negative emotions down, positive emotions up (4/11 RCT); aggression - no
Триптофан.myths: “The mood swings” - in healthy people it is moderate (4/11 RCT), aggression without shift. “500 mg is enough” - awakening only reduces ≥1 g/day.
Триптофан.name: Tryptophan
Триптофан.onset: Course: less awakenings with regular ≥1 g/day; a single dose is not enough.
Триптофан.title: Tryptophan
Триптофан.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Триптофан.who_needs: Poor sleep with frequent awakenings and shallow phases; mild decreased mood/anxiety in healthy people; not with SSRI/MAOI.

Фосфатидилсерин.about: Phospholipid of neuronal membranes: reduces inattention in ADHD in children; “nootropic” has not been confirmed.
Фосфатидилсерин.caution: Phosphatidylserine is a phospholipid. For children with ADHD: there is evidence of improvement in attention and memory (33539192). For cognitive function in healthy adults: limited data. Safe in standard doses (100-300 mg/day). Historically produced from soybeans (formerly cow brain).
Фосфатидилсерин.food_sources: There is no separate source in food: the raw material is soy lecithin (formerly cow brain).
Фосфатидилсерин.guidelines: MA 2021 (PMID 33539192, 216 children): inattention ES 0.36 significant, low quality; SR 2026 (42538853): not confirmed.
Фосфатидилсерин.how_to_choose: 100-300 mg/day PS in courses, standardized composition; for children with ADHD - only with a doctor.
mechs: Phospholipid of neuronal membranes: fluidity + modulation of acetylcholine/dopamine
Memory with age-related decline; in healthy people it is weak
Reducing inattention in children with ADHD
Inattention: ES 0.36 (p=0.01) at 200-300 mg/d; quality is low
Benefits are uneven, no global improvements - adjunctive (SR 11)
Фосфатидилсерин.myths: “Panacea” - SR 2026 (11 works): no enhancer. “ADHD cured” – significant inattention, hyperactivity NS. "Schizophrenia" - memory in 1 work.
Фосфатидилсерин.name: Phosphatidylserine
Фосфатидилсерин.onset: Coursework: in MA the effect on inattention in ADHD; There is no sharp “focus”.
Фосфатидилсерин.title: Phosphatidylserine
Фосфатидилсерин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Фосфатидилсерин.who_needs: Children with ADHD: inattention ES 0.36 (200-300 mg/d), low quality, with a doctor; elderly and healthy - without hard data.

Хлорофилл.about: Chlorophyllin reduces the bioavailability of aflatoxins; “detox” and “for acne” are not confirmed.
Хлорофилл.caution: Chlorophyll/chlorophyllin. There are NO meta-analyses or systematic reviews on clinical effects in PubMed. Popular claims: 'detox', 'antioxidant', 'wound healing', 'anti-carcinogenic' - are not supported by systematic evidence. Chlorophyllin (semi-synthetic water-soluble form) has been studied in the context of reducing aflatoxin absorption, but no systematic reviews are available. Popularity on TikTok/Instagram ≠ evidence.
Хлорофилл.food_sources: Green vegetables - spinach, parsley, cabbage; chlorophyllin - water-soluble form as a supplement.
Хлорофилл.guidelines: Qidong (n=180, 4 months): aflatoxin adducts −55%. Leukopenia: 85% vs 26.7% (n=105). Topically - pilot n=10. MA no.
Хлорофилл.how_to_choose: Chlorophyllin 100 mg/day - only with a known aflatoxin load; on the skin - gel with Cu-chlorophyllin.
mechs: Porphyrin ring; binds odorants in vitro
Complexation of carcinogens in GI: blocking bioavailability
Aflatoxin adducts in urine: −55% (RCT, 180 people, Qidong)
Photodamaged skin: improvement within 8 weeks; pilot n=10
Stimulation of granulopoiesis in leukopenia (Chinese RCT)
Хлорофилл.myths: “Removes toxins” - only aflatoxin against the background of load. “For acne and odor” - no. TikTok trend ≠ evidence.
Хлорофилл.name: Chlorophyll
Хлорофилл.onset: Coursework: in RCT - 3-4 months (aflatoxin -55%); There is no such thing as an acute “detox.”
Хлорофилл.title: Chlorophyll
Хлорофилл.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Хлорофилл.who_needs: Niches only: aflatoxin load (mold food); leukopenia (Chinese RCT); “wellness detox” for healthy people - no data.

Холин.about: Choline is a source of acetylcholine and methyl groups: α-GPC improves cognition in age-related/vascular disorders (MA 2023), in pregnancy - for the fetal brain.
Холин.caution: Security was not dealt with separately in the abstracts; in a number of countries α-GPC is a medicine (MA 2023); during pregnancy, the dose is as recommended by the doctor.
Холин.course: Course - weeks-months; a sustained effect has been described in combination with donepezil.
Холин.food_sources: Egg yolk, liver, meat, soy; Choline is often deficient in plant-based diets, especially during pregnancy (SR 2025).
Холин.guidelines: MA 2023 (7 RCT): α-GPC + donepezil - cognition MD 1.72 [0.20-3.25], behavior MD −7.61; SR 2025: Choline in pregnancy - lower risk of neural tube defects.
Холин.how_to_choose: According to the data - α-GPC form; during pregnancy, the dose is as recommended by the doctor; in healthy individuals, rely on the lack of evidence for cognition.
mechs: α-GPC is a precursor to phosphatidylcholine and acetylcholine
Choline in folate metabolism and neural tube development
lower risk of neural tube defects with sufficient intake
Combination with a cholinesterase inhibitor in patients with neurocognitive disorders
Холин.myths: “Choline makes everyone smarter” - in MA 2023, an effect in patients with cognitive disorders. “There is enough soy lecithin” - different forms, data mainly on α-GPC. “Food provides the norm”—pregnant women do not get enough choline (SR 2025).
Холин.name: Choline
Холин.onset: MA 2023: effect on cognition - during a course (weeks-months), especially in combination with donepezil; acute effects in healthy people are not indicated.
Холин.title: Choline
Холин.who_needs: Adults with cognitive impairment (vascular/age-related) - α-GPC; pregnant and lactating women with low choline in the diet; in healthy people with normal status there is no evidence.

Хром.about: Strengthens insulin receptor signaling; with T2D - weak shifts in glycemia and lipids, weight - no.
Хром.caution: Chromium (usually picolinate). For type 2 diabetes: meta-analyses show small reductions in fasting glucose and HbA1c. For obesity: Cochrane (24293292) shows an INsignificant effect on weight. For PCOS: data available. For pressure: the effect is small. The data are mixed, the clinical significance is controversial. Safe at standard doses (200-1000 mcg/day).
Хром.food_sources: Broccoli, whole grains, potatoes, yeast; You can’t gain 200–400 mcg of dietary chromium.
Хром.guidelines: SR 2024: FPG/HbA1c/HOMA-IR lower in courses 2–6 months; Cochrane 2013: weight unchanged; MA 2025 (PCOS): more ovulations.
Хром.how_to_choose: Picolinate 200–400 mcg/day under glucose control for T2D/PCOS; for healthy weight loss - do not take it.
mechs: FPG, insulin, HbA1c, HOMA-IR are lower in courses of 2–6 months; heterogeneous data
HDL is higher, TG and total cholesterol is lower; hs-CRP and MDA lower (meta-analyses)
PCOS: insulin/LH lower, ovulation more frequent; 200 mcg is better than metformin according to HOMA-IR
Хром.myths: “Fat burner” - Cochrane 2013 (9 RCT, 622): weight is not significant. “Like metformin” - 200 mcg for PCOS reduces HOMA-IR better, RCT quality is modest.
Хром.name: Chromium
Хром.onset: The effect is cumulative: glucose and insulin change over 2–6 months; there is no fast one.
Хром.title: Chromium
Хром.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Хром.who_needs: T2D with poor glycemic control (courses 2–6 months) and PCOS; for weight loss - doesn't work.

Цинк.about: Cofactor of immunity, skin and testosterone synthesis; competes with copper.
Цинк.caution: Effect with ARI: ONLY if you start taking it in the first 24 hours. Lozenges/syrup (not tablets). Dose 75-100 mg/day. Side effects: nausea, metallic taste. >40 mg/day long-term → copper deficiency. For children in developing countries for diarrhea - WHO recommendation.
Цинк.guidelines: EFSA: immunity and skin; NIH: Vegetarians at risk for deficiency.
Цинк.how_to_choose: Picolinate, citrate, gluconate; 15-25 mg elemental zinc; “50 mg + copper” should not be taken without indications.

interactions.note: reduces absorption, separate doses for 2-4 hours

mechs: Synaptic Zn2+ modulates NMDA; cofactor of 300+ enzymes
Antiviral and immune effects of Zn2+: suppression of viral replication in the respiratory tract
Colds are shorter and milder when taking zinc (lozenges)
Reduced prostaglandins and antioxidant (SOD1): less uterine cramps
Support of testosterone synthesis (cofactor of steroidogenesis) in zinc deficiency
Testosterone is higher only with zinc deficiency
Цинк.myths: “Cure a cold in a day” - lozenges slightly shorten the duration. “More - more testosterone” - only in case of deficiency.
Цинк.name: Zinc
Цинк.onset: In case of deficiency (taste, skin, healing) - 4-8 weeks; “immunity” is not subjectively felt.
Цинк.title: Zinc
Цинк.upper_limit: 40 mg/day long-term; months above 50 mg – copper deficiency.
Цинк.who_needs: Vegetarians and vegans (phytates), little animal protein, deficiency according to analysis.

Цистеин.about: Cysteine is a precursor to glutathione; MA for free cysteine ​​is small, the data relate to the NAC derivative (mucolytics for COPD, paracetamol poisoning).
Цистеин.caution: Do not mix cysteine and NAC as equivalents; high-dose amino acids were not assessed in abstracts; for medical conditions - consult a doctor.
Цистеин.food_sources: Meat, poultry, eggs, dairy products, legumes, onions, garlic, broccoli; the diet does not understand abstracts.
Цистеин.guidelines: Cochrane 2018: NAC is an antidote for paracetamol poisoning; MA 2024: mucolytics (including NAC) for COPD reduce exacerbations and hospitalizations; SR 2023: NAC effects vary.
Цистеин.how_to_choose: For free cysteine there is no choice of form - no data; Use NAC according to clinical indications (doctor); There is no benefit shown in conventional dietary supplements.
mechs: reduction in exacerbations and hospitalizations in stable COPD (MA 2024)
NAC as an antidote for paracetamol poisoning
Role of NAC in bipolar disorder
Цистеин.myths: “Cysteine is the same as NAC”—related but different molecules. “It is useful for everyone against oxidation” - healthy data does not exist. “Works for COPD” - talking about a derivative of NAC in a group of patients.
Цистеин.name: Cysteine
Цистеин.onset: Not established: The administration of free cysteine and the timing of effect were not studied in the abstracts.
Цистеин.title: Cysteine
Цистеин.who_needs: There are no direct indications for cysteine supplements in the selection; NAC has been studied for COPD (reduction of exacerbations) and as an antidote for paracetamol overdose; healthy - no data.

Чага.about: Northern mushroom, traditionally used in Russia and Siberia. Modern RCTs in humans are rare - most of the data are in vitro and on animals.
Чага.caution: High oxalate content is contraindicated for kidney stones. May interact with anticoagulants (warfarin) and antidiabetic drugs - risk of hypoglycemia. For autoimmune diseases, be careful.
Чага.food_sources: Chaga tea is a traditional drink. The mushroom itself is inedible, only a decoction or extract.
Чага.guidelines: In Russia, it is a component of traditional medicine and is approved as part of some drugs. FDA/EFSA do not approve health claims.
Чага.how_to_choose: Extract indicating the concentration of polysaccharides (β-glucans 10%+). Avoid cheap powders - they have few active substances.

interactions.note: enhances the anticoagulant effect - INR control
may reduce sugar - risk of hypoglycemia

mechs: Melanins and polysaccharides (β-glucans): activation of macrophages and NK cells
Чага.myths: “Cures cancer” - no, not a single confirmed RCT. “The Soviet pill for everything” is a historical myth, the effect is modest.
Чага.name: Chaga
Чага.onset: 2-4 weeks for immune effect; usually does not produce noticeable changes in well-being.
Чага.title: Chaga
Чага.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. High doses increase the risk of oxalate stones.
Чага.who_needs: Supporters of adaptogens and mushroom medicine. People with chronic inflammation (as measured by CRP). DOES NOT replace treatment.

Чеснок.about: Sulfur-containing compounds: moderate effect on blood pressure and cholesterol.
Чеснок.caution: Garlic (Allium sativum). For blood pressure: meta-analyses show a moderate decrease (-5-8 mmHg systolic). For cholesterol: moderate reduction. For cardiometabolic factors: data available. The effect depends on the form (aged garlic extract is better). Safe in standard doses. Caution: anticoagulants, operations (antiplatelet effect).
effects: Blood pressure −2-4 mm Hg, lipids slightly: moderate
Чеснок.food_sources: Fresh garlic (2-4 cloves/day); additives = allicin extract.
Чеснок.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved; MA - modest effect on blood pressure and cholesterol.
Чеснок.how_to_choose: Standardization 1.3% allicin; aged garlic extract (AGE) is better tolerated.

interactions.note: enhances the effect, risk of bleeding

mechs: Blood pressure −2-4 mm Hg, lipids slightly: moderate
SBP −3.7, DBP −2.0 mmHg; glucose −2.8, HOMA-IR −0.37 (complex MA 2026)
Чеснок.myths: “It will replace statins”—the effect is modest. “Fresh garlic is equivalent” - the additives are more stable.
Чеснок.name: Garlic
Чеснок.title: Garlic
Чеснок.upper_limit: 1200 mg extract/day; higher - GI discomfort, odor.
Чеснок.who_needs: High blood pressure (adjuvant), high cholesterol, prevention.

Чёрный тмин.about: Thymoquinone: Moderately improves glycemia, blood pressure, weight, and inflammation in metabolic diseases.
Чёрный тмин.caution: Black cumin (Nigella sativa, thymoquinone). For inflammation and oxidative stress: data available. For cardiometabolic factors in metabolic syndrome/diabetes: mixed evidence. For asthma: data available. Data are sparse and RCT quality is often poor. Safe in standard doses.
Чёрный тмин.food_sources: Black cumin seeds and their oil as a seasoning; for working doses - 1–2 g of seed powder or oil in a course.
Чёрный тмин.guidelines: GRADE-MA 2026 (31 RCT, 2145): weight −1.59 kg, SBP −3.25, DBP −2.75 mm, FBS −18.6, HbA1c −0.56%; MA: hs-CRP and TNF-α ↓.
Чёрный тмин.how_to_choose: Seed powder 1–2 g/day or oil; standardization for thymoquinone is desirable - the effect is dose-dependent.
mechs: MA 2026 (31 RCT): weight −1.59 kg, SBP −3.25, DBP −2.75 mmHg, FBS −18.6 mg/dL, HbA1c −0.56%
MA (10 RCT): hs-CRP −0.67, TNF-α −2.29, MDA −1.18; TAC +0.35 (high heterogeneity)
Чёрный тмин.myths: “A miracle of everything” - modest effects, on markers. “Reduces insulin” - HOMA-IR does not change (MA 2026). “Seasoning = dose” - you need g/oil.
Чёрный тмин.name: Black Seed
Чёрный тмин.onset: Course effects: weeks-months; for asthma - 4–8 weeks.
Чёрный тмин.title: Black Seed
Чёрный тмин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Чёрный тмин.who_needs: T2D/metabolic syndrome (glucose, HbA1c, blood pressure, weight) and frequent colds/inflammation; for bronchial asthma - adjunct with a doctor.

Шатавари.about: Classic Ayurveda for women's health. The main use is to stimulate lactation in nursing mothers.
Шатавари.caution: Not recommended during pregnancy without consulting a doctor. During lactation, an effect on hormones is possible. Check for human studies - there are few.
Шатавари.food_sources: It is not used as food - the root is taken as an extract or decoction.
Шатавари.guidelines: Not included in the recommendations of EFSA, FDA. Ayurvedic sources indicate widespread use, modern RCTs are limited.
Шатавари.how_to_choose: Standardized extract for saponins 20-40%; Avoid powders of unknown origin.
mechs: Adaptogenic effect: modulation of GABA and serotonin
Шатавари.myths: “Stimulates female hormones in men” - no data. “Works for fertility in everyone” - only limited data for specific groups.
Шатавари.name: Shatavari
Шатавари.onset: 3-7 days for effect on lactation; for an adaptogenic effect - 2-4 weeks.
Шатавари.title: Shatavari
Шатавари.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. Doses up to 1 g/day are considered safe in short courses.
Шатавари.who_needs: Nursing mothers with insufficient milk supply (RCT available). Women in menopause - there is little data, there is traditional use.

Шиитаке.about: The edible mushroom with the most researched evidence base among mushrooms. Lentinan is approved in Japan as an adjuvant for cancer therapy.
Шиитаке.caution: In its raw form it contains lentinan, which is not digested - only eaten cooked. Rarely - allergies. May interact with anticoagulants.
Шиитаке.food_sources: The edible mushroom is a source of vitamins B and D (with UV irradiation). Used in soups, stir-fries, and Asian cuisine.
Шиитаке.guidelines: Lentinan is approved in Japan as an antitumor adjuvant (for clinics, not for dietary supplements). EFSA - no health claims.
Шиитаке.how_to_choose: Fresh or dried mushrooms from the store are more reliable than capsules. When choosing an extract, the concentration of polysaccharides is 20%+.
mechs: Lentinan (β-1,3-glucan): activation of dendritic cells and macrophages
Шиитаке.myths: “Works against all types of cancer” is an exaggeration, only an adjuvant for specific types. “Raw mushrooms are healthier” - raw mushrooms contain indigestible lentinan + risk of poisoning.
Шиитаке.name: Shiitake
Шиитаке.title: Shiitake
Шиитаке.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. Doses up to 2-3 g/day of extract are well tolerated.
Шиитаке.who_needs: Mainly as part of the diet. In capsules - for immune support. NOT to treat anything.

Шлемник.about: Chinese herb with anti-anxiety effect. Studied in RCT, but less so than valerian or passionflower. The effect is soft.
Шлемник.caution: Possible interactions with anticoagulants (warfarin) - risk of bleeding. Rarely - with benzodiazepines, enhances the effect. There is little data available during pregnancy.
Шлемник.food_sources: It is not used as food - only an extract or decoction of the root.
Шлемник.guidelines: Not included in EFSA/FDA recommendations. In TCM it is officially used as an anxiolytic.
Шлемник.how_to_choose: Standardized extract for baicalin 30%+. Check for COA (Certificate of Analysis).

interactions.note: enhances the effect, risk of bleeding

mechs: Flavonoids (baicalin, baicalein): modulation of GABA-A receptors
Orientin and wogonin: antioxidant effects in the CNS
Neuroprotection, reduction of inflammation in the brain
Inhibition of MAO and GABA reuptake
Шлемник.myths: “Replaces antidepressants” - no, it does not work for clinical depression. “Instantly calms” - the effect accumulates.
Шлемник.name: Skullcap
Шлемник.onset: 2-4 weeks of use for a sustainable effect; does not work “at once”.
Шлемник.title: Skullcap
Шлемник.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. In Chinese medicine, doses are up to 9 g/day, in Western RCT - up to 1.5 g/day.
Шлемник.who_needs: People with chronic anxiety, mild-to-moderate. Does not replace therapy for clinical disorders. Students during the session.

Эхинацея.about: Immunomodulator: ARI prevention - slight reduction in incidence (RR 0.78); treatment duration - no effect shown.
Эхинацея.caution: For ARI PREVENTION: significant effect (-22% incidence, Cochrane 2014). For TREATMENT after the onset of symptoms: NO effect. Security: good in the short term (RR 1.09, 0.95-1.25 - not significant). Different species (E. purpurea, E. angustifolia) and extracts - effectiveness varies. Caution: autoimmune diseases.
Эхинацея.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved. Cochrane 2014: heterogeneity among products is high. MA 2019: no effect on duration, RR 0.78 on frequency (clinical significance is debatable).
Эхинацея.how_to_choose: E. purpurea (not angustifolia); alcoholic extract or juice.
mechs: Prevention of colds: the effect is minimal, MAs are contradictory
Prevention of ARI (reduction in episode frequency)
ARI frequency: RR 0.78 (95% CI 0.68-0.88); clinical significance is questionable
Duration of ARI: MD -0.45 days with CI through zero - no effect
Эхинацея.myths: “Prevents colds”—the effect on frequency is modest (RR 0.78). “Reduces duration” - MD −0.45 days, insignificant; effectiveness has not been confirmed.
Эхинацея.name: Echinacea
Эхинацея.onset: Prevention - 4-8 weeks. Treatment duration - effect not confirmed.
Эхинацея.title: Echinacea
Эхинацея.who_needs: Prevention during the season ARI (modest). Treatment of colds - no effect.
